ἀνήρ.g: a male human being, a man
ἀνήρ.long: a male human being; a man, husband.
ἀνήρ.sd: a man (properly as an individual male)
ἀνήρ.as:
ἀνήρ, ἀνδρός, ὁ,
[in LXX chiefly for אִישׁ, freq. אֱנוֹשׁ, also אָדָם, etc.;]
a man, Lat. vir.
1. As opp. to a woman, Ac 8:12, I Ti 2:12; as a husband, Mt 1:16, Jo 4:16, Ro 7:2, Tit 1:6.
2. As opp. to a boy or infant, I Co 13:11, Eph 4:13, Ja 3:2.
3. In appos. with a noun or adj., as ἀ. ἁμαρτωλός, Lk 5:8; ἀ. προφήτης, 24:19; freq. in terms of address, as ἀ. ἀδελφοί, Ac 1:16; and esp. with gentilic names, as ἀ. Ἰουδαῖος, Ac 22:3; ἀ. Ἐφέσιοι, 19:35.
4. In general, a man, a male person: = τις, Lk 8:41, Ac 6:11.
SYN.: ἄνθρωπος, q.v. (cf. MM, VGT, s.v.).

ἀνατολή.g: rising of the sun, the East
ἀνατολή.long: (a) rising of the sun, hence (b) (sing. and plur.) the quarter whence the sun rises, the East.
ἀνατολή.sd: a rising of light, i.e. dawn (figuratively); by implication, the east (also in plural)
ἀνατολή.as:
ἀνατολή, -ῆς, ἡ
(< ἀνατέλλω), [in LXX chiefly for מִזְרָח, קָדִים;]
1.a rising: of light, Lk 1:78.
2.the sun-rising, the east (MM, VGT, s.v.): Mt 2:2, 9, Re 21:13; ἀ. ἡλίου, Re 7:216:12 (WΗ, pl.); pl., Mt 2:18:1124:27, Lk 13:29.†

ἀνοίγω.sd: to open up (literally or figuratively, in various applications)
ἀνοίγω.as:
ἀν-οίγω
(ἀνά, οἴγω = οἴγνυμι), [in LXX chiefly for פָּתַח;]
to open;
1. trans., c. acc.; a door or gate, Ac 5:1912:14, Re 4:1; pass., Ac 12:1016:26, 27; metaph. of opportunity or welcome, Ac 14:27, Col 4:3, Re 3:20; pass., I Co 16:9, II Co 2:12, Re 3:8; absol. (sc. θύραν), Ac 5:2312:16; c. dat. pers., Lk 12:36, Jo 10:3; metaph., Mt 7:7, 825:11, Lk 11:9, 1013:25, Re 3:7; θησαυρούς (Si 43:14), Mt 2:11; τ. μνημεῖα, Mt 27:52; τάφος, Ro 3:13; τ. φρέαρ, Re 9:2; of heaven, Mt 3:16, Lk 3:21, Ac 10:11, Re 11:1915:519:11; σφραγῖδα, Re 5:96:1 ff. 8:1; βιβλίον, βιβλαρίδιον, Lk 4:17, Re 5:2-510:2, 820:12; τ. στόμα, Mt 17:27; id. Hebraistically (Nu 22:28, Jb 3:1, Is 50:5, al.), of beginning to speak, Mt 5:2, Ac 8:32, 3510:3418:14; seq. εἰς βλαιφημίας, Re 13:6; ἐν παραβολαῖς (Ps 77 (78):2), Mt 13:35; of recovering speech, Lk 1:64; of the earth opening, Re 12:16; τ. ὀφθαλμούς, Ac 9:8, 40; id. c. gen. pers., of restoring sight, Mt 9:3020:33, Jo 9:10 ff. 10:2111:37; metaph., Ac 26:18; ἀκοάς, c. gen. pers., of restoring hearing, Mk 7:35.
2. Intrans. in 2 pf., ἀνέῳγα (M, Pr., 154); heaven, Jo 1:51; τ. στόμα, seq. πρός, of speaking freely, II Co 6:11 (cf. δι-ανοίγω and v. MM, VGT, 45).†

ἀνακάμπτω.long: I bend or turn back; I return.
ἀνακάμπτω.as:
ἀνα-κάμπτω,
[in LXX: I Ch 19:5, Je 3:1, al. (שׁוּב), Je 15:5 (סוּר);]
1. trans., to bend or turn back.
2. Intrans., to return: Mt 2:12, Ac 18:21, He 11:15; metaph. (cf. MM, VGT, s.v.), Lk 10:6.†

ἀναχωρέω.long: I return, retire, withdraw, depart (underlying idea perhaps of taking refuge from danger or of going into retirement).
ἀναχωρέω.kj: depart, give place, go (turn) aside, withdraw self
ἀναχωρέω.as:
ἀνα-χωρέω, -ῶ,
[in LXX for בּרח, נוּם, etc.;]
1.to go back.
2.to withdraw: Mt 9:24; freq. in sense of avoiding danger (MM, VGT, s.v.), Mt 2:12 (but v. Thayer), 13, 14, 224:1212:1514:1315:2127:5, Mk 3:7, Jo 6:15, Ac 23:1926:31.†

ἄν.g: an untranslatable word that makes a statement contingent
ἄν.long: an untranslatable word (under the circumstances, in that case, anyhow), the general effect of which is to make a statement contingent, which would otherwise be definite: it is thus regularly used with the subjunctive mood.
ἄν.der: a primary particle, denoting a supposition, wish, possibility or uncertainty
ἄν.as:
ἄν,
conditional particle,
which cannot usually be separately translated in English, its force depending on the constructions which contain it (see further, LS, s.v.; WM, §xlii; M, Pr., 165 ff.; MM, VGT, s.v.).
1. In apodosis,
(i) c. indic, impf. or aor., expressing what would be or would have been if (εἰ c. impf., aor. or plpf.) some condition were or had been fulfilled: Lk 7:3917:6, Jo 5:46, Ga 1:10, Mt 12:724:43, I Co 2:8, Ac 18:14, I Jo 2:19, al. The protasis is sometimes understood (as also in cl.): Mt 25:27, Lk 19:23. In hypothetical sentences, expressing unreality, ἄν (as often in late writers, more rarely in cl.) is omitted: Jo 8:3915:24 19:11, Ro 7:7, Ga 4:15;
(ii) c. opt., inf., ptcp. (cl.; v. LS, s.v.; M, Int., §275; M, Pr., 167:4).
2. In combination with conditional, relative, temporal, and final words;
(i) as in cl., c. subj.,
(a) in protasis with εἰ, in Attic contr. ἐάν, q.v.;
(b) in conditional, relative, and temporal clauses (coalescing with ὅτε, ἐπεί, etc.; v.s. ὅταν, ἐπάν, etc.), ever, soever;
(α) c. pres., ἡνίκα, II Co 3:15; ὃς ἄν, Ro 9:15(LXX)16:2, al.; ὅσοι ἄν, Lk 9:5; ὡς ἄν, Ro 15:24 (M, Pr., 167);
(β) c. aor., ὃς ἄν, Mt 5:21, 22, 31; ἕως ἄν, until, Mt 2:13, Mk 6:10, al.; ὡς ἄν, as soon as (M, Pr., 167), I Co 11:34, Phl 2:23. On the freq. use of ἐάν for ἄν with the foregoing words, v.s. ἐάν;
(ii) in late Gk., when some actual fact is spoken of, c. indic.: ὅταν (q.v.); ὅπου ἄν, Mk 6:56 (M, Pr., 168); καθότι ἄν, Ac 2:454:35; ὡς ἄν, I Co 12:2.
3. in iterative construction, c. impf. and aor. indic. (M, Pr., 167): Ac 2:454:35, I Co 12:2.
4. c. optat., giving a potential sense to a question or wish: Ac 8:3126:29.
5. Elliptical constructions: εἰ μή τι ἄν (M, Pr., 169), I Co 7:5; ὡς ἄν, c. inf., as it were (op. cit. 167), II Co 10:9.

ἀναιρέω.long: I take up, take away the life of, make an end of, murder.
ἀναιρέω.sd: to take up, i.e. adopt; by implication, to take away (violently), i.e. abolish, murder
ἀναιρέω.kj: put to death, kill, slay, take away, take up
ἀναιρέω.der: from G303 (ἀνά) and (the active of) G138 (αἱρέομαι);
ἀναιρέω.as:
ἀν-αιρέω, -ῶ
[in LXX for הרג hi., מֵת hi., נכה hi., etc.;]
1.to take up: mid., Ac 7:21.
2.to take away, make an end of, destroy (for late exx. of various senses, v. MM, VGT, s.v.);
(a) of things (as freq. in cl. of laws, etc.): He 10:9;
(b) of persons, to kill: Mt 2:16, Lk 22:223:32, Ac 2:235:33, 367:289:23-24, 2910:3912:213:2816:2722:2023:15, 2123:2725:326:10, II Th 2:8, WH, txt., R, txt.†

ἀντί.long: (a) instead of, in return for, over against, opposite, in exchange for, as a substitute for, (b) on my behalf, (c) wherefore, because.
ἀντί.sd: opposite, i.e. instead or because of (rarely in addition to)
ἀντί.as:
ἀντί
(the ι is elided only in ἀνθ᾽ ὧν), prep. c. gen. (cf. MM, VGT, s.v.);
1. prop, in local sense, over against, opposite, hence;
2.instead of, in place of, for (Hom., etc.): Mt 5:3817:27, Lk 11:11, I Co 11:15, He 12:2; c. artic. inf. (cl.), Ja 4:15; of succession, Mt 2:22; χάριν ἀ. χάριτος, Jo 1:16 (M, Pr., 100); of price in exchange, He 12:16; λύτρον ἀ. πολλῶν, Mt 20:28, Mk 10:45 (M, Pr., 105); of requital, Ro 12:17, I Th 5:15, I Pe 3:9 (cf. Wi 11:15); ἀνθ᾽ ὧν, because, Lk 1:2019:44, Ac 12:23, II Th 2:10 (cl., LXX for אֲשֶׁרתַּחַת); id. therefore (cl., LXX), Lk 12:3; ἀ. τούτου (LXX for עַל־כֵּן), Eph 5:31. As a prefix, ἀντι- (before vowels ἀντ-, ἀνθ᾽-), denotes
(a)over against, ἀντιπέραν;
(b) co-operation, ἀντιβάλλειν;
(c) requital, ἀντιμισθία;
(d) opposition, ἀντίχριστος;
(e) substitution, ἀνθύπατος. Compounds of ἀ. usually govern dat. (Bl., § 37, 7).†

ἀναβαίνω.long: I go up, mount, ascend; of things: I rise, spring up, come up.
ἀναβαίνω.kj: arise, ascend (up), climb (go, grow, rise, spring) up, come (up)
ἀναβαίνω.der: from G303 (ἀνά) and the base of G939 (βάσις);
ἀναβαίνω.as:
ἀναβαίνω,
[in LXX chiefly for עלה;]
to go up, ascend,
(a) of persons: ἐπί συκομωρέαν, Lk 19:4; εἰς τ. πλοῖον, Mk 6:51; εἰς Ἱεροσόλυμα, Mt 20:17; εἰς τ. ἱερόν, c. inf. (M, Pr., 205), Lk 18:10; with mention of place of departure, Mt 3:16 (ἀπό), Ac 8:39 (ἐκ);
(b) of things, to rise, spring up, come up: a fish, Mt 17:27; smoke, Re 8:4; plants growing, Mt 13:7; metaph., of things coming up in one's mind (as Heb. עָלָה אֶל לֵב; IV Ki 12:4, al.), Lk 24:38, I Co 2:9; of prayers, Ac 10:4; messages, Ac 21:31 (for late exx., v. MM, VGT, s.v.).

ἀνάγω.g: I lead up, put to sea, set sail
ἀνάγω.long: I lead up, bring up, offer, produce, put to sea, set sail.
ἀνάγω.sd: to lead up; by extension to bring out; specially, to sail away
ἀνάγω.kj: bring (again, forth, up again), depart, launch (forth), lead (up), loose, offer, sail, set forth, take up
ἀνάγω.as:
ἀν-άγω
[in LXX chiefly for עָלָה hi.;]
to lead or bring up: seq. είς, c. acc. loc., Mt 4:1, Lk 2:224:5 (WH om. είς, κ.τ.λ.), Ac 9:3916:34; of raising the dead (cl.), ἐκ νεκρῶν, Ro 10:7, He 13:20; to produce and set before, τ. λαῷ, Ac 12:4 (MM, VGT, s.v.); in sacrificial sense (MM, VGT, s.v.), to offer, θυσίαν, Ac 7:41. Mid., in nautical sense (Hom., Hdt., Thuc., al.), to put to sea: Lk 8:22, Ac 13:1316:1118:2120:3, 1321:1, 227:2, 427:12, 2128:10, 11 (cf. ἐπ-ανάγω).†

ἄνθρωπος.g: a man, one of the human race
ἄνθρωπος.long: a man, one of the human race.
ἄνθρωπος.sd: from G3700 (ὀπτάνομαι)); man-faced, i.e. a human being
ἄνθρωπος.as:
ἄνθρωπος, -ου, ὁ,
[in LXX chiefly for אָדָם, אִישׁ, also for אֱנוֹשׁ, etc.;]
man:
1. generically, a human being, male or female (Lat. homo): Jo 16:21; c. art., Mt 4:412:35, Mk 2:27, Jo 2:25, Ro 7:1, al; disting. from God, Mt 19:6, Jo 10:33, Col 3:23, al.; from animals, etc., Mt 4:19, Lk 5:10, Re 9:4, al.; implying human frailty and imperfection, I Co 3:4; σοφία ἀνθρώπων, I Co 2:5; ἀνθρώπων ἐπιθυμίαι, I Pe 4:2; κατὰ ἄνθρωπον περιπατεῖν, I Co 3:3; κατὰ ἄ. λέγειν (λαλεῖν), Ro 3:5, I Co 9:8; κατὰ ἄ- λέγειν, Ga 3:15 (cf. I Co 15:32, Ga 1:11); by meton., of man's nature or condition, ὁ ἔσω (ἔξω) ἄ., Ro 7:22, Eph 3:16, II Co 4:16 (cf. I Pe 3:4); ὁ παλαιὸς, καινὸς, νέος ἄ., Ro 6:6, Eph 2:154:22, 24, Col 3:9, 10; joined with another subst., ἄ. ἔμπορος, a merchant, Mt 13:45 (WH, txt. om. ἄ.); οἰκοδεσπότης, Mt 13:52; βασιλεύς, 18:23; φάγος, 11:19; with name of nation, Κυρηναῖος, Mt 27:32; Ἰουδαῖος, Ac 21:39; Ῥωμαῖος, Ac 16:37; pl. οἱ ἄ., men, people: Mt 5:13, 16, Mk 8:24, Jo 4:28; οὐδεὶς ἀνθρώπων, Mk 11:2, I Ti 6:16.
2. Indef., ἄ. = τις, some one, a man: Mt 17:14, Mk 12:1, al.; τις ἄ., Mt 18:12, Jo 5:5, al.; indef. one (Fr. on), Ro 3:28, Ga 2:16, al.; opp. to women, servants, etc., Mt 10:3619:10, Jo 7:22, 23.
3. Definitely, c. art., of some particular person; Mt 12:13, Mk 3:5, al.; οὗτος ὁ ἄ., Lk 14:30; ὁ ἄ οὗτος, ἐκεῖνος, Mk 14:71, Mt 12:45; ὁ ἄ. τ. ἀνομίας, II Th 2:3; ἄ τ. θεοῦ (of Heb. אֱלֹהִיםאִישׁ), I Ti 6:11, II Ti 3:17, II Pe 1:21; ὁ υἱὸς τοῦ ἀ., v.s. υἱός.
SYN.: ἀνήρ, q.v. (and cf. MM, VGT, 44; Cremer, 103, 635).

ἀνατέλλω.g: I make to rise, I rise, shine
ἀνατέλλω.long: I make to rise, I rise, shine (generally of the sun, and hence met.).
ἀνατέλλω.kj: (a-, make to) rise, at the rising of, spring (up), be up
ἀνατέλλω.der: from G303 (ἀνά) and the base of G5056 (τέλος);
ἀνατέλλω.as:
ἀνα-τέλλω,
[in LXX for צמח, פּרח, זרח, etc.;]
1. trans., to cause to rise: Mt 5:45.
2. Intrans., to rise: φῶς, Mt 4:16 (= Is 9:1); ὁ ἥλιος, Mt 13:6, Mk 4:616:2, Ja 1:11; νεφέλη, Lk 12:54; φωσφόρος, II Pe 1:19; ὁ Κύριος, prob. with ref. to metaph. of sun or star, He 7:14 (cf. ἐξ-ανατέλλω).†

Ἀνδρέας.long: Andrew, brother of Simon Peter, and one of the apostles of Jesus, belonging to Bethsaida.
Ἀνδρέας.as:
Ἀνδρέας, -ου, ὁ,
Andrew, the Apostle: Mt 4:1810:2, Mk 1:16, 293:1813:3, Lk 6:14, Jo 1:41, 456:812:22, Ac 1:13.†

ἀντίδικος.sd: an opponent (in a lawsuit); specially, Satan (as the arch-enemy)
ἀντίδικος.as:
ἀντίδικος, -ον
(< δίκη), [in LXX for רִיב;]
as subst., an opponent in a lawsuit, adversary: Mt 5:25, Lk 12:5818:3, I Pe 5:8 (Cremer, 696; MM, VGT, s.v.).†

ἀνθίστημι.g: I take a stand against, oppose, resist
ἀνθίστημι.long: I set against; I withstand, resist, oppose.
ἀνθίστημι.as:
ἀνθ-ίστημι
(ἀντί, ἵστημι), [in LXX for עמד, יצב, etc.;]
1. in pres., impf., fut. and 1 aor. act., causal, to set against.
2. In mid. and pass., also pf. and 2 aor. act., to withstand, resist, oppose: c. dat., Mt 5:39, Lk 21:15, Ac 6:1013:8, Ro 9:1913:2, Ga 2:11, Eph 6:13, II Ti 3:84:15, Ja 4:7, I Pe 5:9.†

ἀντέχομαι.long: trans: I hold against; intrans: I withstand; mid: I hold out against, hold firmly to, cleave to.
ἀντέχομαι.sd: to hold oneself opposite to, i.e. (by implication) adhere to; by extension to care for
ἀντέχομαι.der: from G473 (ἀντί) and the middle voice of G2192 (ἔχω);
ἀντέχομαι.as:
ἀντ-έχω
(ἀντί, ἔχω), [in LXX for חָזַק hi., etc.;]
1. trans., to hold against.
2. Intrans., to withstand. Mid. 1. in cl., to hold out against.
3. (cf. MM, VGT, s.v.), to hold firmly to, cleave to: c. gen. (v. Bl., § 36, 2), Mt 6:24, Lk 16:13, I Th 5:14 (v. M, Th., in l.), Tit 1:9.†

ἀνομία.sd: illegality, i.e. violation of law or (genitive case) wickedness
ἀνομία.kj: iniquity, X transgress(-ion of) the law, unrighteousness
ἀνομία.as:
ἀνομία, -ας, ἡ
(< ἄνομος), [in LXX for עָוֺן, פֶּשַׁע, תּוֹעֵבָה, רֶשַׁע, etc.;]
lawlessness, iniquity: Mt 7:2313:4123:2824:12, Ro 6:19, II Co 6:14, II Th 2:3, 7, Tit 2:14, He 1:9, I Jo 3:4; in pl. (as LXX, Ps 31:1, al.; v. Bl., § 32, 6; Swete, Mk., 153), of acts or manifestations of lawlessness: Ro 4:7(LXX), He 10:17.†
SYN.: v.s. ἁμάρτημα, ἄνομος.

ἄνεμος.long: the wind; fig: applied to empty doctrines.
ἄνεμος.sd: wind; (plural) by implication, (the four) quarters (of the earth)
ἄνεμος.as:
ἄνεμος, -ου, ὁ
[in LXX for רוּחַ;]
wind: Mt 11:714:24, 30, 32, Mk 4:37, 39, 416:48, 51, Lk 7:248:23, 24, Jo 6:13, Ac 27:7, 14, 15, Ja 3:4, Re 6:137:1; pl., Mt 7:25, 278:26, 27, Lk 8:25, Ac 27:4, Ju 12; οἱ τέσσαρες ἄ. τῆς γῆς, Re 7:1; hence the four quarters of the heavens (v. Deiss., BS, 248; MM, VGT, s.v.), Mt 24:31, Mk 13:27; metaph., of variable teaching, Eph 4:14.†
SYN.: πνεῦμα, πνοή (and cf. θύελλα, λαῖλαψ).

ἀνακλίνω.g: I make to recline, I recline at a table
ἀνακλίνω.long: I lay upon, lean against, lay down, make to recline; pass: I lie back, recline.
ἀνακλίνω.as:
** ἀνα-κλίνω,
[in LXX: III Mac 5:16*;]
to lay upon, lean against, hence,
(a)to lay down: Lk 2:7;
(b)to make to recline: Mk 6:39, WH, mg., Lk 12:37. Pass., to lie back, recline: Mt 8:1114:19, Lk 13:29.†
SYN.: ἀνάκειμαι (q.v.), ἀναπίπτω.

ἀνίστημι.g: I raise up, set up, rise from
ἀνίστημι.long: I raise up, set up; I rise from among (the) dead; I arise, appear.
ἀνίστημι.sd: to stand up (literal or figurative, transitive or intransitive)
ἀνίστημι.kj: arise, lift up, raise up (again), rise (again), stand up(-right)
ἀνίστημι.as:
ἀν-ίστημι
(ἀνά, ἵστημι), [in LXX chiefly for קוּם;]
1. causal, in fut. and 1 aor. act., c. acc., to raise up: Ac 9:41; from death, Jo 6:39, Ac 2:32; to raise up, cause to be born or appear: Mt 22:24, Ac 3:22, 26.
2. Intrans., in mid. and 2 aor act.;
(a)to rise: from lying, Mk 1:35; from sitting, Lk 4:16; to leave a place, Mt 9:9; pleonastically, as Heb. קוּם, before verbs of going, Mk 10:1, al. (v. Dalman, Words, 23; M, Pr., 14); of the dead, Mt 17:23, Mk 8:31; seq. ἐκ νεκρῶν, Mt 17:9, Mk 9:9;
(b)to arise, appear: Ac 5:36, Ro 15:12 (cf. ἐπ-, ἐξ- ἀνίστημι, and v. Cremer, 306, 738; MM, VGT, s.v.).
SYN.: ἐγείρω.

ἀνάκειμαι.g: I recline, especially at a dinner-table
ἀνάκειμαι.long: I recline, especially at a dinner-table.
ἀνάκειμαι.sd: to recline (as a corpse or at a meal)
ἀνάκειμαι.kj: guest, lean, lie, sit (down, at meat), at the table
ἀνάκειμαι.as:
** ἀνά-κειμαι
[in LXX: I Es 4:10, To 9:6א*;]
1. in cl., as pass. of ἀνατίθημ, to be laid up, laid: Mk 5:40 Rec.
2. In late writers (cf. MM, VGT, s.v.) = κεῖσθαι, κατακεῖσθαι, to recline at table: Mt 26:20; part. ἀνακείμενος, Mt 9:1022:10, 1126:7, Mk 6:2614:1816:14, Lk 22:27, Jo 6:1112:213:23, 28.†
SYN.: ἀνακλίνω, ἀναπίπτω, the latter denoting an act rather than a state and thus in Jo 13:25 differing from ἀνάκειμαι (see. Jo 13:23) by indicating a change of position.

ἀνεκτός.der: comparative of a derivative of G430 (ἀνέχομαι);
ἀνεκτός.as:
* ἀν-εκτός, -όν
(also in late Gk. -ή, -όν; < ἀνέχομαι),
tolerable: compar., -ότερος, Mt 10:1511:22, 24, Lk 10:12, 14.†

ἄνευ.g: without, without the cooperation or knowledge of
ἄνευ.long: without, without the cooperation (or knowledge) of.
ἄνευ.as:
ἄνευ,
prep. c. gen. (rarer than χωρίς, q.v.; cf. Ellic. on Eph 2:12; MM, VGT, 42),
without: Mt 10:29, I Pe 3:14:9.†

ἀναβλέπω.g: I look up, recover my sight
ἀναβλέπω.long: I look up, recover my sight.
ἀναβλέπω.sd: to look up; by implication, to recover sight
ἀναβλέπω.as:
ἀνα-βλέπω
[in LXX chiefly for נשׂא;]
1.to look up: Mk 8:24, al.; seq. εἰς, Mt 14:19, al. (Xen., Plat.).
2.to recover sight (Plat., Aristoph.; cf. MM, VGT, s.v.): Mt 11:5, Jo 9:11, al.

ἀναπαύω.g: I make to rest, give rest to, rest, take my ease
ἀναπαύω.long: I make to rest, give rest to; mid. and pass: I rest, take my ease.
ἀναπαύω.sd: (reflexively) to repose (literally or figuratively (be exempt), remain); by implication, to refresh
ἀναπαύω.as:
ἀνα-παύω,
[in LXX for fourteen different words, chiefly נוּחַ, also רָבַץ, שָׁאַן, etc.;],
to give intermission from labour, to give rest, refresh: Mt 11:28, I Co 16:18, Phm 20; pass., Phm 7, II Co 7:13. Mid., to ta, rest, enjoy rest: Mt 26:45, Mk 6:3114:41, Lk 12:19, Re 6:1114:13; as in Heb. of Is 11:2 (נוּחַ עַל), τὸ πνεῦμα ἐφ' ὑμᾶς ἀ., I Pe 4:14. (In π. this word is used as a technical agricultural term; v. MM, VGT, s.v.; and cf. Le 26:34 f.; Cremer, 826.)†

ἀνάπαυσις.as:
ἀνά-παυσις, -εως, ή
(ἀνάπαύω), [in LXX chiefly for נוּחַ and its derivatives, שַׁבָּת and its cognates (Ex, Le);]
cessation, rest, refreshment: Mt 11:2612:43, Lk 11:24, Re 4:814:11.†
SYN.: ἄνεσις (lit, the relaxation of the strings of a lyre), prop. signifies the rest or ease which comes from the relaxation of unfavourable conditions, as, e.g. affliction: ἀνάπ., the rest which comes from the temporary cessation of labour (v. Tr., Syn., § xl; Cremer, 827; MM, VGT, s.v.)

ἀναγινώσκω.long: I read, know again, know certainly, recognize, discern.
ἀναγινώσκω.sd: to know again, i.e. (by extension) to read
ἀναγινώσκω.as:
ἀνα-γινώσκω
(Attic ἀναγιγν-), [in LXX chiefly for קרא;]
1.to know certainly, know again, recognize.
2. Of written characters, to read: Mt 24:15, Mk 13:14, Ac 15:3123:34, Eph 3:4; c. acc rei, Mt 22:31, Mk 12:10Lk 6:3, Jo 19:20, Ac 8:30, 32, II Co 1:13, Re 1:3; c. acc pers., Ἠσαίαν τ. προφήτην, Ac 8:28, 30; seq. ἐν, Mt 12:521:42, Mk 12:26 (so. ἐν τ. νόμῳ), Lk 10:26; seq. ὅτι, Mt 19:421:16; τί ἐποίησε, Mt 12:3, Mk 2:25; pass. II Co 3:2; of reading aloud (MM, VGT, s.v.), Lk 4:16, Ac 13:2715:21, II Co 3:15, Col 4:16, I Th 5:27 (M, Th., in l.).†

ἀναίτιος.der: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and G159 (αἴτιος) (in the sense of G156 (αἰτία));
ἀναίτιος.as:
ἀν-αίτιος, -ον
(< αἰτία), [in LXX: De 19:10, 1321:8, 9 (נָקִי), Da LXX TH Sus 62, always of αἷμα (of. MM, VGT, s.v.)*;]
guiltless, innocent: Mt 12:5, 7.†

ἄνυδρος.long: without water, dry; subst: dry places, desert.
ἄνυδρος.der: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and G5204 (ὕδωρ);
ἄνυδρος.as:
ἄνυδρος, -ον
(< ἀ- neg., ὕδωρ), [in LXX for צִיָּה, יְשִׁימוֹן (γῆ ἄ), etc.;]
waterless: τόποι, Mt 12:43, Lk 11:24; πηγαί, II Pe 2:17; νεφέλαι, Ju 12 (MM, VGT, s.v.).†

ἀναπληρόω.g: I fill up, make up, fulfill
ἀναπληρόω.long: I fill up, make up, complete the measure of, fulfill, carry out the commands (provisions, etc.) of.
ἀναπληρόω.sd: to complete; by implication, to occupy, supply; figuratively, to accomplish (by coincidence ot obedience)
ἀναπληρόω.as:
ἀνα-πληρόω, -ῶ,
[in LXX chiefly for מלא, Le 12:6, al.; also שׁלם (Ge 15:16, III Ki 7:51, Is 60:20), etc.;]
1.to fill up, make full (in π. of completing contracts and making up rent; cf. MM, VGT, s.v.): τόπον, take one's place (cf. Heb. מָקוֹםמִלֵּא), I Co 14:16; άμαρτίας, complete the number, I Th 2:16; τ. νόμον, observe perfectly, Ga 6:2; pass., προφητεία, fulfilled, Mt 13:14.
2.to supply: τὸ ὑστέρημα, I Co 16:17, Phl 2:30 (Cremer, 838).†

ἀνά.g: and, apiece, by, each, every, in, through
ἀνά.long: prep. Rare in NT; prop: upwards, up; among, between; in turn; apiece, by; as a prefix: up, to, anew, back.
ἀνά.sd: properly, up; but (by extension) used (distributively) severally, or (locally) at (etc.)
ἀνά.kj: and, apiece, by, each, every (man), in, through
ἀνά.as:
ἀνά
prep. (the rarest in NT; M, Pr., 98; MM, VGT, s.v.), prop.,
upwards, up, always c. acc.
1. In phrases: ἀ. μέσον, among, between, c. gen., Mt 13:25, Mk 7:31, I Co 6:5 (M, Pr., 99), Re 7:17 [so in LXX for בְּתוֹךְ]; ἀ. μέρος, in turn, I Co 14:27 (both found in Polyb.; cf. MGr.ἀνάμεσα).
2. Distrib., apiece, by: Mt 20:9-10, Lk 9:3 (WH om.), Lk 9:14Lk 10:1, Jo 2:6, Re 4:8.
3. Adverbially ("a vulgarism," Bl., § 51, 5; cf. Deiss., BS, 139 f.), ἀ. εἷς ἕκαστος, Re 21:21.
As prefix, ἀ. signifies
(a)up: ἀναβαίνειν;
(b)to: ἀναγγέλλειν;
(c)anew: ἀναγεννᾶν;
(d)back: ἀνακάμπτειν.†

ἀναβιβάζω.long: I draw up, as a net to shore.
ἀναβιβάζω.sd: to cause to go up, i.e. haul (a net)
ἀναβιβάζω.der: from G303 (ἀνά) and a derivative of the base of G939 (βάσις);
ἀναβιβάζω.as:
ἀνα-βιβάζω
(causal of ἀναβαίνω), [in LXX chiefly for עלה hi., also for רכב hi., etc.;]
to make go up, draw up, as a ship (Xen.): σαγήνην, Mt 13:48 (metaph., MM, VGT, s.v.).†

ἀναγκάζω.as:
ἀναγκάζω
(< ἀνάγκη), [in LXX: Pr 6:7 (שֹׁטֵר), I Es 3:24, I Mac 2:25, al.;]
to necessitate, compel by force or persuasion, constrain: c. acc., II Co 12:11; id. c. inf., Mt 14:22, Mk 6:45, Lk 14:23, Ac 26:11 (on the impf. here, v. Field, Notes, 141; M, Pr., 128 f., 247), Ga 2:146:12; pass., C. inf., Ac 28:19, Ga 2:3 (for exx., v. MM, VGT, s.v.).†

ἄνιπτος.der: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of G3538 (νίπτω);
ἄνιπτος.as:
* ἄνιπτος, -ον
(ἀ. neg., νίπτω),
unwashed: Mt 15:20, Mk 7:2 (5 Rec).†

ἀναπίπτω.g: I lie down, recline, fall back upon
ἀναπίπτω.long: I lie down, recline (at a dinner-table), fall back upon (the breast of another person reclining at dinner).
ἀναπίπτω.sd: to fall back, i.e. lie down, lean back
ἀναπίπτω.as:
ἀνα-πίπτω,
[in LXX: Ge 49:9 (כּרע) To 2:17:8, Jth 12:10, Si 25:1835 (32):2, Da TH Sus 37*;]
1. (cl.) to fall back.
2. In late writers = ἀνα-κλίνομαι, to recline for a repast (MM, VGT, s.v.): at table, Lk 11:3714:1017:722:14, Jo 13:1221:20; on the ground, Mt 15:35, Mk 6:408:6, Jo 6:10; to lean back, Jo 13:25 (T, ἐπιπεσών; v.s. ἀνάκειμαι, ad fin.).†
SYN.: ἀνάκειμαι (q.v.), ἀνακλίνομαι.

ἀντάλλαγμα.der: from a compound of G473 (ἀντί) and G236 (ἀλλάσσω);
ἀντάλλαγμα.as:
ἀντ-άλλαγμα, -τος, τό
(ἀντί, ἄλλαγμα; < ἀλλάσσω), [in LXX chiefly for מְחִיר;]
an exchange, the price received as an equivalent for an article of commerce: Mt 16:26, Mk 8:37 (cf. Si 26:14; and v. Swete, Mk. 8:37; Cremer, 90).†

ἀναφέρω.g: I carry up, lead up, offer up
ἀναφέρω.long: (a) I carry up, lead up, (b) I offer up (on a high altar) as a sacrifice, offer up to God on high.
ἀναφέρω.as:
ἀνα-φέρω,
[in LXX chiefly for עלה hi., also for קטר hi., etc.;]
1.to carry or lead up: c. acc. pers., Mt 17:1, Mk 9:2; pass., Lk 24:51 (WH, rejects, R, mg. omits); ἀ. τ. ἁμαρτίας ἐπὶ τ. ξύλον (v. Deiss., BS, 88 f.; ICC, in l.; MM, VGT, s.v.): I Pe 2:24.
2. In LXX and NT, to bring to the altar, to offer (v. Hort on I Pe 2:24): θυσίας, etc., He 7:2713:15, I Pe 2:5; ἐπί τ. θυσιαστήριον, Ja 2:21 (v. Mayor, in l.).
3.to bear, sustain (cf. Nu 14:33, Is 53:12): He 9:28.†

ἀνέχομαι.long: I endure, bear with, have patience with, suffer, admit, persist.
ἀνέχομαι.sd: to hold oneself up against, i.e. (figuratively) put up with
ἀνέχομαι.der: middle voice from G303 (ἀνά) and G2192 (ἔχω);
ἀνέχομαι.as:
ἀν-έχω,
[in LXX chiefly for אפק hithp.;]
to hold up; in NT always mid., to bear with, endure: in cl. most freq. c. acc., but in NT c. gen. pers., Mt 17:17, Mk 9:19, Lk 9:41, II Co 11:1, 19, Eph 4:2, Col 3:13; seq. μικρόν τι, c. gen. pers. and c. gen. rei, II Co 11:1; c. dat. rei, II Th 1:4 (v M, Th., in l.); seq. εἴ τις, II Co 11:20; absol., I Co 4:12, II Co 11:4; to bear with = to listen to, c. gen. pers., Ac 18:14; c. gen. rei, II Ti 4:3, He 13:22 (cf. προσανέχω and MM, VGT, s.v.).†

ἀνάγκη.long: necessity, constraint, compulsion; there is need to; force, violence.
ἀνάγκη.sd: constraint (literally or figuratively); by implication, distress
ἀνάγκη.kj: distress, must needs, (of) necessity(-sary), needeth, needful
ἀνάγκη.der: from G303 (ἀνά) and the base of G43 (ἀγκάλη);
ἀνάγκη.as:
ἀνάγκη, -ης, ἡ
[in LXX chiefly for מָצוֹק, צַר;]
1.necessity: ἔχειν ἀ-, c. inf., to be compelled, Lk 14:1823:17 (Rec., R, mg.), I Co 7:37, Ju 3, He 7:27; ἐξ ἀ., κατ' ἀ., of necessity, II Co 9:7, He 7:12, Phm 14; ἀ. μοι ἐπίκειται, n. is laid on me, I Co 9:16; c. inf. (= ἀναγκαῖον ἐστι), Mt 18:7, Ro 13:5, He 9:16, 23
2.force, violence, hence pain, distress (Diod., al.; LXX; v. M, Th., 41; MM, VGT, s.v.; cf. θλίψις): Lk 21:23, I Co 7:26, I Th 3:7; pl. (v. Bl., § 32, 6; Swete, Mk., 153), ἐν ἀ., II Co 6:412:10.†

ἀνάστασις.sd: a standing up again, i.e. (literally) a resurrection from death (individual, genitive case or by implication, (its author)), or (figuratively) a (moral) recovery (of spiritual truth)
ἀνάστασις.kj: raised to life again, resurrection, rise from the dead, that should rise, rising again
ἀνάστασις.as:
ἀνά-στασις, -εως, ἡ
(< ἀνίστημι), [in LXX: Ze 3:8 (קוּם), La 3:63 (קִימָה), Ps 64 (66) tit., Da LXX 11:20, II Mac 7:1412:43*;]
1.a raising up, awakening, rising (in Inscr. of the erection of a monument, v. MM, VGT, s.v.): Lk 2:34.
2.a rising from the dead (v. DCG, ii, 605b);
(a) of Christ: Ac 1:222:314:33, Ro 6:5, Phl 3:10, I Pe 3:21; ἐξ ἀ. νεκρῶν, Ro 1:4 (ICC, in l.); ἐκ νεκρῶν, I Pe 1:3;
(b) of persons in OT hist. (e.g. III Ki 17:17 ff.): He 11:35;
(c) of the general resurrection: Mt 22:23, 28, 30, Mk 12:18, 23, Lk 20:27, 33, 36, Jo 11:24, Ac 17:1823:824:15, II Ti 2:18; ἀ. ἐκ νεκρῶν, Lk 20:35, Ac 4:2; τῶν νεκρῶν, Mt 22:31, Ac 17:3223:624:2126:23, I Co 15:12, 13, 21, 42, He 6:2; ἀ. ζωῆς, resurrection to life (cf. II Mac 7:14, ἀ. εἰς ζωήν) and ἀ. τ. κρίσεως, r. to judgment, Jo 5:29; ἀ. τ. δικαίων, Lk 14:14; κρείττων ἀ., He 11:35; on ἡ ἀ. ἡ πρώτη, Re 20:5, 6, v. Swete, in l., Westc. on Jo 5, but v. also Thayer, s.v.; by meton. of Christ as Author of ἀ., Jo 11:25 (v. DB, iv, 231; Cremer, 307).†

ἀναβοάω.g: I shout upwards, cry out, raise my voice
ἀναβοάω.long: I shout upwards, cry out, raise my voice.
ἀναβοάω.as:
ἀνα-βοάω, -ῶ
[in LXX for צעק, זעק, קרא, etc.;]
to cry out: Mt 27:46 (WH, ἐβόησεν; v. MM, VGT, s.v.).†

ἄνωθεν.g: from above, from the beginning, again
ἄνωθεν.long: (a) from above, from heaven, (b) from the beginning, from their origin (source), from of old, (c) again, anew.
ἄνωθεν.sd: from above; by analogy, from the first; by implication, anew
ἄνωθεν.kj: from above, again, from the beginning (very first), the top
ἄνωθεν.as:
ἄνωθεν
adv,
(< ἄνω),
(a)from above: ἀπὸ ἄ., Mt 27:51, Mk 15:38; ἐκ τῶν ἄ., Jo 19:28; meaning, from heaven: Jo 3:3119:11, Ja 1:173:15, 17 .
(b)from the first, from the beginning: Lk 1:3, Ac 26:5; whence
(c)anew, again: Jo 3:3, 7, (so most, but v. Meyer, in l.; cf. Field, Notes, 86 f.); πάλιν ἄ., Ga 4:9 (MM, VGT, s.v.).†

ἀνακράζω.as:
ἀνα-κράζω
[in LXX for קרא, etc.;]
to cry out, shout: Mk 1:236:49, Lk 4:338:2823:18.†

ἀναστενάζω.as:
ἀνα-στενάζω,
[in LXX: La 1:4 (אנח ni.), Si 25:18 (17), Da TH Sus 22, II Mac 6:30*;]
to sigh deeply: Mk 8:12.†

ἄναλος.der: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and G251 (ἅλς);
ἄναλος.as:
** ἄναλος, -ον
(< ἅλς), [in Aq.: Ez 13:10, 11, 1522:28*;]
saltless, insipid: Mk 9:50.†

ἀναπηδάω.as:
ἀνα-πηδάω, -ῶ
(< πηδάω, to leap), [in LXX: I Ki 20:34 (קוּם) 25:10, Es 5:1, To4*;]
to leap up: Mk 10:50 (Rec. ἀναστάς).†

ἀναμιμνῄσκω.long: I remind, admonish, am reminded, remind myself; pass: I remember, recall.
ἀναμιμνῄσκω.kj: call to mind, (bring to , call to, put in), remember(-brance)
ἀναμιμνῄσκω.as:
ἀνα-μιμνήσκω
[in LXX for זכר hi.;]
to remind, call to one's remembrance: c. acc. rei, I Co 4:17; c. inf., II Ti 1:6. Pass., to remember, call to mind: Mk 11:2114:72, II Co 7:15, He 10:32.†

ἀνάγαιον.sd: above the ground, i.e. (properly) the second floor of a building; used for a dome or a balcony on the upper story
ἀνάγαιον.as:
* ἀνάγαιον (Rec. ἀνώγεον; on the form, v. Rutherford, NPhr., 357 f.; MM, VGT, s.v.), -ου, τό
(< ἀνά, γῆ),
an upper room: Mk 14:15, Lk 22:12.†
SYN.: ὑπερῷον.

ἀναθεματίζω.long: I curse, invoke curses, devote to destruction.
ἀναθεματίζω.sd: to declare or vow under penalty of execration
ἀναθεματίζω.kj: (bind under a) curse, bind with an oath
ἀναθεματίζω.as:
† ἀνα-θεματίζω
(< ἀνίθεμα), [in LXX chiefly for חרם hi. (Nu 21:2, I Ki 15:3, al.), I Mac 5:5;]
to devote to destruction, declare or invoke anathema: absol., Mk 14:71; ἐαντόν, to bind oneself under a curse: Ac 23:12, 1423:21 (cf. καταναθεματίζω, and on the occurrence of the word in π., v. Deiss., LAE, 92 f.; MM, VGT, s.v.).†

ἀνασείω.g: I shake up, stir up, excite
ἀνασείω.long: I shake up, stir up, excite.
ἀνασείω.as:
** ἀνα-σείω,
[in Aq.: I Ki 26:19, Jb 2:3; Aq., Sm.: Is 36:18*;]
1.to shake out, shake back, move to and fro (Thuc., al.).
2. In late writers (Diod., al.; v. MM, VGT, s.v.), to stir up; metaph., to excite: τ. ὄχλον, Mk 15:11; τ. λαόν, Lk 23:5.†

ἀναλαμβάνω.long: I take up, raise; I pick up, take on board; I carry off, lead away.
ἀναλαμβάνω.as:
ἀνα-λαμβάνω,
[in LXX chiefly for נשׂא, also for לקח, etc.;]
1.to take up, raise: Mk 16:19, Ac 1:2, 111:2210:16, I Ti 3:16.
2.to take up, take to oneself: Ac 7:4320:13, 1423:31, Eph 6:13, 16, II Ti 4:11 (for late exx., v MM, VGT, s.v.).†

ἀνατάσσομαι.long: I arrange, draw up, compose, but perhaps: I set down from memory, restore from memory.
ἀνατάσσομαι.der: from G303 (ἀνά) and the middle voice of G5021 (τάσσω);
ἀνατάσσομαι.as:
† ἀνα-τάσσομαι,
[in LXX only as v.l. (Ald.) in Ec 2:20;]
to arrange in order, bring together from memory (Blass., Phil. Gosp., 14 ff.; MM, VGT, s.v.): Lk 1:1.†

ἀναφωνέω.as:
ἀνα-φωνέω, -ῶ,
[in LXX for שׁמע hi., זכר hi.;]
to cry out, exclaim: Lk 1:42 (Arist., al.).†

ἀντιλαμβάνομαι.g: I take hold of, help, share in
ἀντιλαμβάνομαι.long: I take hold of, help, share in, partake of, enjoy.
ἀντιλαμβάνομαι.sd: to take hold of in turn, i.e. succor; also to participate
ἀντιλαμβάνομαι.der: from G473 (ἀντί) and the middle voice of G2983 (λαμβάνω);
ἀντιλαμβάνομαι.as:
ἀντι-λαμβάνω,
[freq. in LXX for חזק hi., תּמךְ, etc;]
to take instead of or in turn. Mid., c. gen., to take hold of;
(a) of persons, to help (v. MM, VGT, s.v.): Lk 1:54, Ac 20:35;
(b) of things, to partake of: I Ti 6:2 (v. Field, Notes, 210; Cremer, 386; and cf. συν-αντιλαμβάνω).†

ἀνάδειξις.long: the proclamation of an appointment (to an office); perhaps rather admission to membership of a society.
ἀνάδειξις.as:
**† ἀνά-δειξις, -εως, ἡ
(< ἀναδείκνυμι), [in LXX: Si 43:6*;]
a shewing forth, announcement: Lk 1:80.†

ἀνευρίσκω.long: I find by seeking out, discover.
ἀνευρίσκω.as:
** ἀν-ευρίσκω
(ἀνά, εὑρίσκω), [in LXX: IV Mac 3:14*;]
to find out by search, discover (v. Field, Notes, 47 f.): Lk 2:16, Ac 21:4.†

ἀντιλέγω.g: I speak or say in opposition, contradict
ἀντιλέγω.long: I speak or say in opposition, contradict (oppose, resist).
ἀντιλέγω.kj: answer again, contradict, deny, gainsay(-er), speak against
ἀντιλέγω.as:
ἀντι-λέγω,
[in LXX: Ho 4:4 (רִיב hi.), Is 50:5 (סוּג ni.) Is 22:2265:2, Si 4:25, III Mac 2:28, IV Mac 4:78:2*;]
contradict, oppose, resist (v. Field, Notes, 106; MM, VGT, s.v.); absol.: Ac 28:19, Ro 10:21, Tit 1:92:9; c. dat., Jo 19:12, Ac 13:45; c. acc. et inf., Lk 20:27 T; pass., Lk 2:34, Ac 28:22.†

Ἅννα.long: Anna, a prophetess, who visited the infant Jesus.
Ἅννα.as:
Ἄννα, -ας, ἡ (Heb. חָנָּה),
Anna, a prophetess: Lk 2:36.†

ἀνθομολογέομαι.long: I make a mutual agreement; I confess, acknowledge, formally admit, give thanks to.
ἀνθομολογέομαι.sd: to confess in turn, i.e. respond in praise
ἀνθομολογέομαι.der: from G473 (ἀντί) and the middle voice of G3670 (ὁμολογέω);
ἀνθομολογέομαι.as:
ἀνθ-ομολογέομαι, -οῦμαι
(ἀντί, ὁμολογέομαι), [in LXX: Ps 78 (79):13 (יָדָה), Da LXX 4:34 (שְׁבַּח), I Es 8:91, Si 20:2, III Mac 6:33*;]
1.to make a mutual agreement (Dem., Polyb.).
2.to acknowledge fully, confess (Diod., Polyb., cf. I Es 8:91).
3. C. dat. pers., to declare one's praises, speak fully in prayer or thanksgiving, give thanks to (cf. Ps 78 (79):13): Lk 2:38 (Cremer, 771; MM, VGT, s.v.).†

ἀναζητέω.long: I seek out, search for (implying the difficulty of the task).
ἀναζητέω.as:
ἀνα-ζητέω, -ῶ
[in LXX: Jb 3:4 (דרשׁ), Jb 10:6 (בּקשׁ pi.), II Mac 13:21*;]
to look for or seek carefully ("specially of searching for human beings, with an implication of difficulty": MM, VGT, s.v.): Lk 2:44, 45, Ac 11:25.†

Ἅννας.as:
Ἄννας, -α (FlJ, Ἄνανος, -ου), ὁ (Heb. חָנַן),
Annas, the high priest: Lk 3:2, Jo 18:13, 24, Ac 4:6.†

ἀναπτύσσω.der: from G303 (ἀνά) (in the sense of reversal) and G4428 (πτύσσω);
ἀναπτύσσω.as:
ἀνα-πτύσσω,
[in LXX for פּרשׂ, etc.;]
to unroll: τ. βιβλίον, Lk 4:17 (WH, R, ἀνοίξας).†

ἀνάβλεψις.as:
ἀνά-βλεψις, -εως, ή
(< ἀναβλέπω), [in LXX: Is 61:1 (פְּקַח־קוֹחַ)*;]
recovery of sight: Lk 4:18(LXX).†

ἄνοια.der: from a compound of G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and G3563 (νοῦς);
ἄνοια.as:
ἄνοια, -ας, ἡ
(< ἄ-νοος, without understanding), [in LXX: Pr 14:822:15 (אִוֶּלֶת), Wi 15:18, al.;]
folly, foolishness: II Ti 3:9; expressed in violent rage (cf. Plat., Tim., 86B): Lk 6:11.†

ἀντιμετρέω.g: I measure in return, give equivalent measure
ἀντιμετρέω.long: I measure in return, give equivalent measure.
ἀντιμετρέω.as:
*† ἀντι-μετρέω, -ῶ,
to measure in return: Lk 6:38 (WH, mg., μετρέω).†

ἀνακαθίζω.sd: properly, to set up, i.e. (reflexively) to sit up
ἀνακαθίζω.as:
* ἀνα-καθ-ίζω
(v.s. καθίζω);
1. trans., to set up.
2. Intrans., to sit up: Lk 7:15 (WH, mg., ἐκάθισεν), Ac 9:40 (freq. in medical writings: MM, VGT, s.v.).†

ἀντιπέρα.g: on the opposite side or shore
ἀντιπέρα.long: on the opposite side or shore.
ἀντιπέρα.as:
*† ἀντί-περα (Rec. ἀντιπέραν, LTr. ἀντιπέρα,) adv., = cl. ἀντιπέρας (MM, VGT, 49),
on the opposite side: c. gen., Lk 8:26.†

ἀνάλημψις.as:
* ἀνά-λημψις, -εως, ἡ
(κοινή form of ἀνάληψις; v. Th., Gr., 108 f.),
a taking up: Lk 9:51 (MM, VGT, s.v.).†

ἀναλίσκω.sd: properly, to use up, i.e. destroy
ἀναλίσκω.der: from G303 (ἀνά) and a form of the alternate of G138 (αἱρέομαι);
ἀναλίσκω.as:
ἀν-αλίσκω
(on the etymology, v. MM, VGT, s.v.), [in LXX chiefly for אכל also for כּלה, etc.;]
1.to expend.
2.to consume, destroy: Lk 9:54, Ga 5:15, II Th 2:8, Rec. WH, mg.†

ἀναδείκνυμι.g: I show forth, show clearly, proclaim, appoint
ἀναδείκνυμι.long: I show forth, show clearly; hence: I proclaim (a person's appointment to an office), appoint.
ἀναδείκνυμι.sd: to exhibit, i.e. (by implication) to indicate, appoint
ἀναδείκνυμι.as:
ἀνα-δείκνυμι,
[in LXX: Hb 3:2 (יָדַע), Da LXX 1:11 (מָנָה), Da 1:20 (מָצָא), I Es6, II, III Mac9*;]
1.to lift up and show, show forth, declare (cf. II Mac 2:8, v. MM, VGT, s.v.): Ac 1:24.
2.to consecrate, set apart, (Strab., Plut., Anth.): Lk 10:1.†

ἀντιπαρέρχομαι.long: I pass opposite, on the opposite side of the road.
ἀντιπαρέρχομαι.kj: pass by on the other side
ἀντιπαρέρχομαι.as:
**† ἀντι-παρ-έρχομαι,
[in LXX: Wi 16:10*;]
to pass by opposite to: Lk 10:31, 32 (MM, VGT, s.v.).†

ἀναίδεια.der: from a compound of G1 (Α) (as a negative particle (compare G427 (ἄνευ))) and G127 (αἰδώς);
ἀναίδεια.as:
** ἀναιδία (Rec. -εία, as in cl.), -ας, ἡ
(< αἰδώς), [in LXX: Si 25:22*;]
shamelessness, importunity: Lk 11:8 (for exx. from π., v. MM, VGT, s.v.).†

ἀνέκλειπτος.sd: not left out, i.e. (by implication) inexhaustible
ἀνέκλειπτος.der: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of G1587 (ἐκλείπω);

ἀναλύω.long: I unloose, unloose for departure, depart, return.
ἀναλύω.sd: to break up, i.e. depart (literally or figuratively)
ἀναλύω.as:
** ἀνα-λύω
[in LXX: I Es 3:3, To 2:9, Jth 13:1, Si 3:15, Wi3, Mac10*;]
1.to unloose.
2.to unloose for departure, depart (MM, VGT, s.v.): from life, Phl 1:23
3.to return, Lk 12:36.†

ἀνάπτω.long: I kindle, set on fire, light.
ἀνάπτω.as:
ἀν-άπτω,
[in LXX chiefly for יצת;]
to kindle: Lk 12:49, Ja 3:5 (MM, VGT, s.v.).†

ἀνακύπτω.long: I raise myself, look up, am elated.
ἀνακύπτω.sd: to unbend, i.e. rise; figuratively, be elated
ἀνακύπτω.der: from G303 (ἀνά) (in the sense of reversal) and G2955 (κύπτω);
ἀνακύπτω.as:
ἀνα-κύπτω
[in LXX: Jb 10:15 (נָשָׂא רֹאשׁ), Da LXX, Su 35*;]
to lift oneself up;
(a) bodily; Lk 13:11, Jo 8:7, 10;
(b) mentally, to be elated: Lk 21:28 (cf. MM, VGT, s.v.).†

ἀνορθόω.g: I make straight again, rear again, restore
ἀνορθόω.long: I make upright (straight) again, rear again, restore.
ἀνορθόω.der: from G303 (ἀνά) and a derivative of the base of G3717 (ὀρθός);
ἀνορθόω.as:
ἀν-ορθόω, -ῶ
(ἀνά, ὀρθόω, to set straight, set up), [in LXX chiefly for כּוּן hi.;]
to set upright or straight again, restore: of persons, Lk 13:13, He 12:12; of things, σκηνήν, Ac 15:16 (MM, VGT, s.v.; Cremer, 807).†

ἀντίκειμαι.long: I resist, oppose, withstand, lie opposite to.
ἀντίκειμαι.sd: to lie opposite, i.e. be adverse (figuratively, repugnant) to
ἀντίκειμαι.as:
ἀντί-κειμαι,
[in LXX for איב, צוּר, שׂטן, etc.;]
1.to lie opposite to.
2.to oppose, withstand, resist: c. dat., Lk 13:1721:15, Ga 5:17, I Ti 1:10; as participial subst. (ὁ) ἀντικείμενος, I Co 16:9, Phl 1:28, II Th 2:4, I Ti 5:14 (Cremer, 746).†

ἀνασπάω.long: I drag up, pull up, draw up, draw out.
ἀνασπάω.as:
ἀνα-σπάω, -ῶ,
[in LXX for לקח, עלה hi.;]
to draw up: Lk 14:5, Ac 11:10 (in π. of pulling up barley; MM, VGT, s.v.).†

ἀνταποκρίνομαι.long: I contradict, reply against, give a hostile answer.
ἀνταποκρίνομαι.as:
† ἀντ-απο-κρίνομαι
(ἀντί, ἀποκρίνω), [in LXX: Jg 5:29, Jb 16:9 (8) 32:12 (ענה)*;]
to answer again, reply against: seq. πρός, c. acc. rei, Lk 14:6; c. dat. pers., Ro 9:20.†

ἀνώτερον.long: higher, to a more honorable place (at the dinner table); previously, in an earlier passage (or a book), above.
ἀνώτερον.sd: upper, i.e. (neuter as adverb) to a more conspicuous place, in a former part of the book
ἀνώτερον.as:
ἀνώτερος, α, -ον,
[in LXX: Ne 3:25 (עֶלְיוֹן), Ez 41:7 (מַעַל), To 8:3*;] only in neut., as adv. (cf. ἐξώτερος),
(a) of motion, higher: Lk 14:10;
(b) of rest, above, before: He 10:8.†

ἀνταπόδομα.g: a gift in return, a return, a recompense
ἀνταπόδομα.long: a gift in return (for another), a return, recompense, requital.
ἀνταπόδομα.as:
† ἀντ-από-δομα, -τος, τό
(< ἀνταποδίδωμι), [in LXX chiefly for גְּמוּל;] ( = cl. -δοσις, q.v.),
requital;
(a) in favourable sense: Lk 14:12;
(b) in unfavourable sense: Ro 11:9.†

ἀνάπηρος.der: from G303 (ἀνά) (in the sense of intensity) and (maimed);
ἀνάπηρος.as:
** ἀνά-πηρος (WH, -ειρος; v. Field, Notes, 67), -ον (πηρός, maimed),
[in LXX: To 14:2א, II Mac 8:24*;]
maimed, crippled: Lk 14:13, 21.†

ἀνταποδίδωμι.as:
ἀντ-απο-δίδωμι
(ἀντί, ἀποδίδωμι), [in LXX for שׁלם pi., גּמל, שׁוּב hi., etc.;]
to give back as an equivalent, recompense, requital (the ἀντί expressing the idea of full, complete return; v. Lft., Notes, 46);
(a) in favourable sense: Lk 14:14, Ro 11:35, I Th 3:9;
(b) in unfavourable sense: Ro 12:19, II Th 1:6, He 10:30.†

ἀναζάω.g: I come to life again, revive
ἀναζάω.long: I come to life again, revive, regain life.
ἀναζάω.as:
**† ἀνα-ζάω, -ῶ,
[in Al.: Ge 45:27*;]
to live again, regain life (cf. cl. ἀναβιόω; Cremer, 722; and for other exx., v MM, VGT, s.v.): metaph. of moral revival, Lk 15:24 (WH, mg., ἔζησεν); of sin, Ro 7:9.†

ἀνένδεκτος.der: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of the same as G1735 (ἐνδέχεται);
ἀνένδεκτος.as:
*† ἀν-ένδεκτος, -ον
(< ἀ- neg., ἔνδεκτος; < ἐνδέχομαι),
impossible, inadmissible: Lk 17:1.†

ἀναφαίνω.long: (a) a nautical term: I sight (a place), (b) mid: I appear (as it were, out of the unseen), (c) I bring to light, make to appear.
ἀναφαίνω.sd: to show, i.e. (reflexively) appear, or (passively) to have pointed out
ἀναφαίνω.as:
ἀνα-φαίνομαι,
[in LXX for צדק hi., גּלשׁ;]
to bring to light, make to appear: ἀναφάναντες τ. Κύπρον, i.e. having sighted C.: Ac 21:3 WH; pass., to appear, be made manifest: Lk 19:11.

ἀνάθεμα.long: a votive offering, a thing devoted to God; a curse, the thing cursed.
ἀνάθεμα.sd: a (religious) ban or (concretely) excommunicated (thing or person)
ἀνάθεμα.as:
† ἀνάθεμα, -τος, τό
(< ἀνατίθημι), Hellenistic for Attic ἀνάθημα (Bl., § 27, 2);
1. prop. = τὸ ἀνατιθέμένον, that which is laid by to be kept, a votive offering (as ἀνάθημα in II Mac 2:13, Lk 21:5—where LT read -θεμα, v. M, Pr., 46).
2. [As equiv. in LXX for חֵרֶם,] devoted, a thing devoted to God (v. Driver, De., 98 f., and cf. Le 27:28-29), hence;
(a) of the sentence pronounced (De 13:15), a curse: Ac 23:14;
(b) of the object on which the curse is laid, accursed (De 7:26): Ro 9:3, I Co 12:316:22, Ga 1:8, 9 (v. ICC on Ro.; Lft., Ga., 1:8, 9; Cremer, 547; Tr., Syn., § v; MM, VGT, s.v.).†

ἀνάμνησις.as:
ἀνάμνησις, -εως, ἡ
(< ἀναμιμνήσκω), [in LXX: Ps 37 (38), 69 (70) tit. (זכר hi.), Le 24:7 (אַזְכָּרָה), Nu 10:10 (זִכְרוֹן), Wi 16:6*;]
remembrance: εἰς τ. ἐμὴν ἀ., Lk 22:19 (WH om.), I Co 11:24, 25; ἀ. ἁμαρτιῶν, He 10:3 (v. Abbott, Essays, 122 ff.; DCG, ii, 74a).†
SYN.: ὑπόμνησις (v. Tr., Syn., § cvii).

ἄνομος.sd: lawless, i.e. (negatively) not subject to (the Jewish) law; (by implication, a Gentile), or (positively) wicked
ἄνομος.kj: without law, lawless, transgressor, unlawful, wicked
ἄνομος.der: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and G3551 (νόμος);
ἄνομος.as:
ἄ-νομος, -ον
(ἀ. neg., νόμος), [in LXX for עָוֺן, פֶּשַׁע, רֶשַׁע, etc.;]
1.lawless, wicked: Mk 15:28, Lk 22:37, Ac 2:23, I Ti 1:9, II Pe 2:8; ὁ ἄ., II Th 2:8 (= ὁ ἄνθρωπος τῆς ἀνομίας, II Th 2:3).
2.without law (= οἱ μὴ ὑπὸ νόμον, Ro 2:14): I Co 9:21 (MM, VGT, s.v.).†
SYN.: v.s. ἄθεσμος.

ἀναπέμπω.g: I send up to a higher tribunal, I send back
ἀναπέμπω.long: I send up (to a higher tribunal), send back.
ἀναπέμπω.as:
* ἀνα-πέμπω
1.to send up,
(a) to a higher place (Æsch., Plat., al.);
(b) to a higher authority (Deiss., BS, 229; MM, VGT, s.v.; cf. also Field, Notes, 140): Lk 23:7, 15, Ac 25:21.
2.to send back (Pind.): Lk 23:11, Phm 11.†

ἀνακρίνω.long: I examine, inquire into, investigate, question.
ἀνακρίνω.sd: properly, to scrutinize, i.e. (by implication) investigate, interrogate, determine
ἀνακρίνω.kj: ask, question, discern, examine, judge, search
ἀνακρίνω.as:
ἀνα-κρίνω
[in LXX: I Ki 20:12 (חקר), Da LXX Su 13, ib. LXX ,TH 48, 51*;]
to examine, investigate, question (Lft., Notes, 181 f.): Ac 17:11, I Co 2:14, 154:3, 49:310:2510:2714:24; in forensic sense (MM, VGT, s.v.; esp. of examination by torture; v. Field, Notes, 120 f.), Lk 23:14, Ac 4:912:1924:828:18.†
SYN.: v.s. ἐξετάζω.

ἀντιβάλλω.g: I throw at in opposition, exchange words with
ἀντιβάλλω.long: I throw at in opposition, exchange (words) with, perhaps: I compare.
ἀντιβάλλω.as:
** ἀντι-βάλλω,
[in LXX: II Mac 11:13*;]
to throw in turn, exchange: metaph., λόγους (cf. Lat. conferre sermones; v. Field, Notes, 81), Lk 24:17.†

ἀνόητος.der: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of G3539 (νοιέω);
ἀνόητος.as:
ἀ-νόητος, -ον
(ἀ- neg., νοητός; < νοέω), [in LXX: Pr 17:28 (אֱוִיל), Si 42:8, al.;]
1.not thought on, not understood (Hom., Plat.).
2.not understanding, foolish (Hdt., al., LXX): Lk 24:25, Ro 1:14, Ga 3:1, 3, I Ti 6:9, Tit 3:3 (Cremer, 438, 790; MM, VGT, s.v.).†
SYN.: ἀσύνετος (v. Tr., Syn., § lxxv).

ἄνω.long: up, above, up to the top, up to the brim, things above, heaven, the heavenly region.
ἄνω.as:
ἄνω,
adv.
(< ἀνά),
(a)up, upwards: Jo 11:41, He 12:15;
(b)above (opp. to κάτω): Ac 2:19; with art. ἡ, Ga 4:26, Phl 3:14; τά, Jo 8:23, Col 3:1, 2; ἕως ἄ. (up to the brim), Jo 2:7 (Cremer, 106; MM, VGT, s.v.).†

ἀντλέω.long: I draw (generally water from a deep well in the ground); perhaps: I draw out.
ἀντλέω.sd: to bale up (properly, bilge water), i.e. dip water (with a bucket, pitcher, etc.)
ἀντλέω.as:
ἀντλέω, -ῶ
(< ἄντλος, bilge-water in a hold), [in LXX for שׁאב, etc.;]
1. prop., to bale out.
2. Generally, to draw water: absol., Jo 2:84:15; ὕδωρ, Jo 2:94:7 (on its use of the water made wine, v. DCG, ii, 815a; MM, VGT, s.v.; Field, Notes, 84 f.).†

ἀναστρέφω.g: I overturn, turn upside down, return, mid. and pass: I conduct myself, live
ἀναστρέφω.long: I overturn; I turn back, return; I turn hither and thither; pass: I turn myself about; I sojourn, dwell; I conduct myself, behave, live.
ἀναστρέφω.sd: to overturn; also to return; by implication, to busy oneself, i.e. remain, live
ἀναστρέφω.kj: abide, behave self, have conversation, live, overthrow, pass, return, be used
ἀναστρέφω.as:
ἀνα-στρέφω,
[in LXX chiefly for שׁוּב;]
1.to overturn: Jo 2:15.
2.to turn back, return: Ac 5:2215:16.
3.to turn hither and thither; pass., to turn oneself about, sojourn, dwell: Mt 17:22 Rec.; metaph. (like Heb. הלךְ, in κοινή writers and in π.; v. Deiss., LAE, 315; BS, 88, 194; MM, VGT, s.v.), to conduct oneself, behave, live: II Co 1:12, Eph 2:3, I Ti 3:15, He 10:3313:18, I Pe 1:17, II Pe 2:18.†
SYN.: περιπατέω (Hellenistic), πολιτεύω.

ἄντλημα.long: what is drawn; a vessel or bucket to draw with.
ἄντλημα.as:
*† ἄντλημα, -τος, τό
(< ἀντλέω),
(a) prop., what is drawn (Diosc.);
(b)a vessel to draw with, a bucket (Plut.; v. Abbott, Essays, 88): Jo 4:11.†

ἀναγγέλλω.long: I bring back word, report; I announce, declare.
ἀναγγέλλω.kj: declare, rehearse, report, show, speak, tell
ἀναγγέλλω.der: from G303 (ἀνά) and the base of G32 (ἄγγελος);
ἀναγγέλλω.as:
ἀν-αγγέλλω,
[in LXX chiefly for נגד hi.;]
1.to bring back word, report (Æsch., Thuc., al.): Jo 5:15 (WH, εἶπεν), Ac 14:2715:4, II Co 7:7
2. Later, = ἀπαγγέλλω (MM, VGT, s.v.), to announce, declare (LXX; Cremer, 24): Mt 28:11 (WH, ἀπ-), Jo 4:2516:13-15, Ac 19:1820:20, 27Ro 15:21, I Pe 1:12, I Jo 1:5.†

ἀνέρχομαι.long: I come up, go up, ascend.
ἀνέρχομαι.as:
ἀν-έρχομαι,
[in LXX: III Ki 13:12 (הָלַךְ)*;]
to go up: Jo 6:3, Ga 1:17, 18 (cf. ἐπανέρχ-; and on its use of "going up" to the capital, MM, VGT, s.v.).†

ἀνθρωποκτόνος.as:
* ἀνθρωποκτόνος, -ον
(< κτείνω, to kill),
a murderer, manslayer (Eur.; v. MM, VGT, s.v.): Jo 8:44, I Jo 3:15.†
SYN.: φονεύς, ἀνδροφόνος (v. Tr., Syn, § lxxxiii).

ἀνθρακιά.long: a coal-fire, a heap of burning coals.
ἀνθρακιά.as:
** ἀνθρακιά, -ᾶς, ἡ
(< ἄνθραξ), [in LXX: Si 11:32, IV Mac 9:20*;]
a heap of burning coals: Jo 18:1821:9.†

ἀνάψυξις.sd: properly, a recovery of breath, i.e. (figuratively) revival
ἀνάψυξις.as:
ἀνά-ψυξις, -εως, ἡ
(< ἀναψύχω), [in LXX: Ex 8:15 (11 (רְוָחָה)*;]
a refreshing: Ac 3:19.†

Ἁνανίας.long: Ananias, (a) husband of Sapphira, a member of the early church at Jerusalem, (b) a member of the church at Damascus, (c) the high priest at Jerusalem.
Ἁνανίας.sd: Ananias, the name of three Israelites
Ἁνανίας.as:
Ἀνανίας (WH, Ἁναν-), -α, ὁ (Heb. חֲנַנְיָה),
Ananias;
1. of Jerusalem: Ac 5:1, 35:5.
2. Of Damascus: Ac 9:10-13, 1722:12.
3. High Priest: Ac 23:224:1.†

Ἀντιοχεύς.long: an Antiochian, an inhabitant of Antioch.
Ἀντιοχεύς.sd: an Antiochian or inhabitant of Antiochia
Ἀντιοχεύς.as:
Ἀντιοχεύς, -έως, ὁ,
a citizen of Antioch, an Antiochian: Ac 6:5.†

ἀναγνωρίζομαι.g: I make known to again, make to be recognized
ἀναγνωρίζομαι.long: I recognize; pass: I am made known, cause myself to be recognized.
ἀναγνωρίζομαι.der: middle voice from G303 (ἀνά) and G1107 (γνωρίζω);
ἀναγνωρίζομαι.as:
ἀνα-γνωρίζω
[in LXX: Ge 45:1 (ידע hith.)*;]
to recognize: Ac 7:13 (WH, txt., ἐγνωρίσθη).†

ἀνατρέφω.long: I rear, bring up, nourish, educate.
ἀνατρέφω.as:
** ἀνα-τρέφω,
[in LXX: Wi 7:4 B, IV Mac 10:211:15א*;]
to nurse up, nourish, educate, bring up: Lk 4:16, WΗ, mg., Ac 7:20, 2122:3.†

ἀντιπίπτω.g: I fall foul of, resist, oppose
ἀντιπίπτω.long: I resist, oppose, fall against or upon.
ἀντιπίπτω.der: from G473 (ἀντί) and G4098 (πίπτω) (including its alternate);
ἀντιπίπτω.as:
ἀντι-πίπτω,
[in LXX: Ex 26:5 (קבל), Ex 26:17 (שׁלב), Nu 27:14 (מְרִיבָה), Jb 23:13 (שׁוּב hi.)*;]
1.to fall against or upon (Arist., Polyb.).
2.to strive against, resist (Arist.): c. dat., Ac 7:51.

ἀναίρεσις.long: taking away (of life), killing, slaying, murder.
ἀναίρεσις.as:
ἀν-αίρεσις, -εως, ἡ
(< ἀναιρέω), [in LXX: Nu 11:15 (הָרַג), Jg 15:17 (רָמָה), Jth 15:4, II Mac 5:13*;]
1.a taking up or away (Thuc.).
2.a destroying, slaying, murder (Field, Notes, 116; MM, VGT, s.v.): Ac 8:1.†

ἀναγκαῖος.as:
** ἀναγκαῖος, -αῖα, -αῖον
(< ἀνάγκη), [in LXX: Es 8:13, Wi 16:3, Sir prol. 22, II Mac 4:239:21, IV Mac 1:2*;]
1.necessary: Ac 13:46, I Co 12:22, II Co 9:5, Phl 2:25, Tit 3:14, He 8:3; comp. -αιότερον, Phl 1:24.
2. Of persons connected by bonds of nature or friendship, near, intimate (Field, Notes, 118; ΜΜ, VGT, s.v.): ἀ. φίλοι, Ac 10:24.†

Ἀντιόχεια.long: Antioch, (a) Antioch on the river Orontes, capital of the Province Syria, (b) "Pisidian" Antioch, not in Pisidia, but near Pisidia, in the Roman Province Galatia.
Ἀντιόχεια.as:
Ἀντιόχεια, -ας, ἡ,
Antioch;
1. in Syria: Ac 11:19, 20, 22, 26, 2713:114:2615:22, 23, 30, 3518:22, Ga 2:11.
2. In Pisidia: Ac 13:1414:19, 21, II Ti 3:11.†

ἀνθύπατος.sd: instead of the highest officer, i.e. (specially) a Roman proconsul
ἀνθύπατος.der: from G473 (ἀντί) and a superlative of G5228 (ὑπέρ);
ἀνθύπατος.as:
* ἀνθ-ύπατος, -ου, ὁ
(ἀντί, ὕπατος, altern. for ὑπέρτατος),
supreme, a consul, one acting in place of a consul, a proconsul, the administrator of a senatorial province (cf. ἡγεμών, and v. MM, VGT, 44): Ac 13:7, 8, 1218:1219:38.†

ἀνάγνωσις.long: recognition, reading; public reading (of the law and prophets in synagogue or church).
ἀνάγνωσις.as:
ἀνά-γνωσις, -εως, ἡ
[in LXX: Ne 8:8 (מִקְרָא), I Es 9:48, Sir prol. 9, 13*;]
1.recognition (Hdt.).
2.reading (Plat., al.): of the public reading of Scripture (Milligan, NTD, 173, 210 f.): Ac 13:15, II Co 3:14, I Ti 4:13 (Cremer, 158; MM, VGT, s.v.).†

ἀνοικοδομέω.long: I rebuild, build up (what has fallen or been razed to the ground), sometimes merely: I build.
ἀνοικοδομέω.as:
ἀν-οικο-δομέω, -ῶ,
[in LXX for בּנה, גּדר;]
to build again, rebuild (MM, VGT, s.v.): Ac 15:16.†

ἀνασκευάζω.long: I pervert, subvert, dismantle, unsettle, overthrow, destroy.
ἀνασκευάζω.sd: properly, to pack up (baggage), i.e. (by implication, and figuratively) to upset
ἀνασκευάζω.der: from G303 (ἀνά) (in the sense of reversal) and a derivative of G4632 (σκεῦος);
ἀνασκευάζω.as:
* ἀνα-σκευάζω
(< σκεῦος, a vessel),
prop. to pack up baggage, hence, to dismantle, ravage, destroy; metaph., to unsettle, subvert (MM, VGT, s.v.): ψυχάς, Ac 15:24.†

ἀνίημι.g: I let go, loosen, release, give up, neglect
ἀνίημι.long: I send up, produce, send back; I let go; I relax, loosen, hence met: I give up, desist from.
ἀνίημι.sd: to let up, i.e. (literally) slacken or (figuratively) desert, desist from
ἀνίημι.as:
ἀν-ίημι
(ἀνά, ἵημι), [in LXX for רפה, נשׂא, etc.;]
1.to send up, produce, to send back.
2.to let go, leave without support: He 13:5 (cf. De 31:6; Hom., Il., ii, 71).
3.to relax, loosen (v. Field, Notes, 124 f.): Ac 16:2627:40; hence, metaph., to give up, desist from: Eph 6:9.†

ἀναστατόω.g: I turn upside down, upset, unsettle
ἀναστατόω.long: (perhaps a political metaphor), I turn upside down, upset, unsettle.
ἀναστατόω.sd: properly, to drive out of home, i.e. (by implication) to disturb (literally or figuratively)
ἀναστατόω.kj: trouble, turn upside down, make an uproar
ἀναστατόω.der: from a derivative of G450 (ἀνίστημι) (in the sense of removal);
ἀναστατόω.as:
† ἀνα-στατόω, ῶ
(< ἀνάστατος, driven from home; < ἀνίστημι), [in LXX: Da 7:23 (דּוּשׁ;* also in Aq., and in π. (v. Deiss., LAE, 80 f.; MM, VGT, s.v.),]
to stir up, excite, unsettle: c. acc.;
(a) to tumult and sedition: Ac 17:621:38;
(b) by false teaching: Ga 5:12 (v. Milligan, NTD, 73 f.).†

ἀναθεωρέω.long: I look at attentively, gaze at, consider.
ἀναθεωρέω.sd: to look again (i.e. attentively) at (literally or figuratively)
ἀναθεωρέω.as:
† ἀνα-θεωρέω, -ῶ
to observe carefully, consider well: Ac 17:23, He 13:7 (Diod., al.).†

ἀνθρώπινος.long: belonging to human beings (especially as contrasted with God), human (as contrasted with divine).
ἀνθρώπινος.kj: human, common to man, man(-kind), (man-)kind, men's, after the manner of men
ἀνθρώπινος.as:
ἀνθρώπινος, -η, ον
(< ἄνθρωπος), [in LXX for אָדָם, אֱנוֹשׁ;]
human, belonging to man: χεῖρες, Ac 17:25; σοφία, I Co 2:13; φύσις, Ja 3:7; κτίσις, I Pe 2:13 (MM, VGT, s.v.); ἀ. ἡμέρα, opp. to ἡ ἡμ. (3:13, God's Judgment-Day), human judgment, I Co 4:3 (v. Lft., Notes, 198); πειρασμὸς ἀ., temptation such as man can bear (AV, such as is common to man, v. Field, Notes, 175), I Co 10:13; ἀνθρώπινον λέγω, I speak in human fashion, with words not properly weighed, Ro 6:19 (v. Field, Notes, 156).†

ἀντιτάσσομαι.long: I set myself against, resist (the attack of).
ἀντιτάσσομαι.sd: to range oneself against, i.e. oppose
ἀντιτάσσομαι.der: from G473 (ἀντί) and the middle voice of G5021 (τάσσω);
ἀντιτάσσομαι.as:
ἀντι-τάσσω (Att., -ττω),
[in LXX for לוּץ hi., נשׂא, etc.;]
to range on battle against; mid., to set oneself against, resist: absol., Ac 18:6; c. dat., Ro 13:2, Ja 4:65:6, I Pe 5:5 (MM, VGT, s.v.).†

ἀναπείθω.g: I urge by evil persuasion, I tempt
ἀναπείθω.as:
ἀνα-πείθω,
[in LXX: Je 29:8 (נשׂא hi.), I Mac 1:11*;]
to persuade, incite: Ac 18:13 (cf. MM, VGT, s.v.).†

ἀναντίρρητος.long: indisputable, undeniable, not to be contradicted.
ἀναντίρρητος.der: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of a compound of G473 (ἀντί) and G4483 (ῥέω);
ἀναντίρρητος.as:
† ἀν-αντί-ρητος
(T, -ρρητος), -ον (< ῥητός, spoken), [in Sm.: Jb 11:233:13*;]
not to be contradicted, undeniable: Ac 19:36 (MM, VGT, s.v.).†

ἄντικρυς.long: right opposite, off (nautical sense), over against.
ἄντικρυς.as:
** ἄντικρυς (Tr. -ύς, Rec. ἀντικρύ), adv.
(< ἀντί), [in LXX: Ne 12:8 (לְנֶגֶד), III Mac 5:16*;]
in cl., outright; in κοινή (= cl. καταντικρύ), over against: Ac 20:15 (v. Bl., § 5, 4; 40, 7; Rutherford, NPhr., 500 f.; MM, VGT, s.v.).†

ἀναβαθμός.g: a step, a flight of steps
ἀναβαθμός.long: a step, a flight of steps; the well-known "stairs" leading up from the temple to the tower of Antonia at Jerusalem.
ἀναβαθμός.as:
ἀνα-βαθμός, -οῦ, ὁ
(< ἀναβαίνω), [in LXX for מַעֲלָה: III Ki 10:19, 20, IV Ki 9:1320:9 ff, II Ch 9:18, 19, Is 38:8, Ez 40:6, 49; ᾠδὴ τῶν ἀ., tit. 119(120)-133(134)*;]
1.a going up, an ascent (Pss, tit. 119(120)-133(134) ?).
2.a step (LXX); pl., a flight of stairs: Ac 21:35, 40. (On the formation -θμός, v. MM, VGT, s.v.)†

ἀνετάζω.long: I examine (a person on trial, a witness) judicially (frequently by the aid of torture).
ἀνετάζω.as:
† ἀν-ετάζω
(< ἀνά, ἐτάζω, to examine; v. MM, VGT, s.v.), [in LXX: Jg 6:29 (דָּרַשׁ), Es 2:23 (בָּקַשׁ), Da TH Su 14*;]
to examine judicially: Ac 22:24, 29.†

Ἀντιπατρίς.long: Antipatris, a town, where was a Roman colony, on the road between Caesarea and Jerusalem.
Ἀντιπατρίς.as:
Ἀντιπατρίς, -ίδος, ἡ,
Antipatris, bet. Joppa and Caesarea: Ac 23:31.†

ἀναδίδωμι.g: I send up, deliver, hand over
ἀναδίδωμι.long: I send up, deliver, hand over, yield.
ἀναδίδωμι.as:
** ἀνα-δίδωμι
[in LXX: Si 1:22, II Mac 13:15*;]
1.to give forth, send up, as of plants (Hdt., al.).
2.to give up, yield, hand over (MM, VGT, s.v.): Ac 23:33.†

ἀναβάλλομαι.long: I postpone, defer, especially: I postpone the trial of.
ἀναβάλλομαι.der: middle voice from G303 (ἀνά) and G906 (βάλλω);
ἀναβάλλομαι.as:
ἀνα-βάλλω,
[in LXX: Ps 78:2189:38 (עבר), I Ki 28:14, Ps 104:2 (עטה);]
to defer, put off (MM, VGT, s.v.): mid., Ac 24:22.†

ἄνεσις.as:
ἄνεσις, -εως, ἡ,
(< ἀνίημι), [in LXX: II Es 4:22 (שָׁלוּ), II Ch 23:15, I Es 4:62, Wi 13:13, Si 15:2026:10*;]
a loosening, relaxation: Ac 24:23 (RV, indulgence; cf. MM, VGT, s.v.); by St. Paul, opp. to θλίψις, expressed or understood, relief: II Co 2:127:58:13, II Th 1:7.†
SYN.: ἀνάπαυσις (q.v.).†

ἀνατίθεμαι.g: I lay a case before, impart, communicate, relate
ἀνατίθεμαι.long: I lay (a case) before, impart, communicate, declare, relate (with a view to consulting).
ἀνατίθεμαι.sd: to set forth (for oneself), i.e propound
ἀνατίθεμαι.der: from G303 (ἀνά) and the middle voice of G5087 (τίθημι);
ἀνατίθεμαι.as:
ἀνα-τίθημι,
[in LXX chiefly for חרם (Cremer, 546);]
to lay upon, set up, etc. Mid. -εμαι, in late writers (Plut., al.; v. also MM, VGT, s.v.), to set forth, declare: Ac 25:14, Ga 2:2.†

ἀναβολή.as:
ἀναβολή, -ῆς, ἡ
(< άαβάλλω), [in LXX for כּנף, etc.;]
delay: Ac 25:17 (for exx. of other meanings, v. MM, VGT, s.v.).†

ἀνάκρισις.as:
** ἀνά-κρισις, -εως, ἡ,
[in LXX: III Mac 7:5*;]
an examination: spec. of legal preliminary investigation, Ac 25:26 (v. MM, VGT, s.v.).†

ἀνεύθετος.long: unfitted, unsuitable, inconvenient, not well placed.
ἀνεύθετος.der: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and G2111 (εὔθετος);
ἀνεύθετος.as:
*† ἀν-εύ-θετος, -ον
(v. MM, VGT, s.v.),
not well placed, not fit: Ac 27:12.†

ἀντοφθαλμέω.long: I face (lit: "I present my eye to"), resist, withstand; as nautical term: I bear up against the wind.
ἀντοφθαλμέω.der: from a compound of G473 (ἀντί) and G3788 (ὀφθαλμός);
ἀντοφθαλμέω.as:
**† ἀντοφθαλμέω, -ῶ
(ἀντί, ὀφθαλμός), [in LXX: Wi 12:14*;]
to look in the face, look straight at (Polyb.). Metaph., to face, withstand (Wi 12:14, Polyb.): c. dat., ἀ. τ. ἀνέμῳ, as nautical term, to beat up against the wind (v. DB, ext., 366 f.; MM, VGT, s.v.): Ac 27:15.†

ἀναδέχομαι.long: I welcome, receive kindly; I undertake, assume the responsibility of.
ἀναδέχομαι.as:
** ἀνα-δέχομαι
[in LXX: II Mac 6:198:36*;]
1.to assume, undertake (in π. freq. as legal term: MM, VGT, s.v.): ἐπαγγελίας, He 11:17.
2. = cl. ὑποδέχομαι, to receive: of guests, Ac 28:7.†

ἀναπολόγητος.der: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of G626 (ἀπολογέομαι);
ἀναπολόγητος.as:
*† ἀναπολόγητος, -ον
(< ἀπολογεόμαι),
without excuse, inexcusable (in Polyb., al., as a forensic term; v. Lft., Notes, 252): Ro 1:202:1.†

ἀντιμισθία.der: from a compound of G473 (ἀντί) and G3408 (μισθός);
ἀντιμισθία.as:
*† ἀντιμισθία, -ας, ἡ
(< ἀντίμισθος, for a reward),
a reward, requital: in good sense, II Co 6:13; in bad sense, Ro 1:27 (MM, VGT, s.v.).†

ἀνελεήμων.der: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and G1655 (ἐλεήμων);
ἀνελεήμων.as:
ἀν-ελεήμων, -ον
(< -ἀ, ἐλεήμων), [in LXX for אַכְזָר;]
without mercy: Ro 1:13.†

ἀνοχή.long: forbearance, suspense or delay (of punishment), patience.
ἀνοχή.as:
** ἀνοχή, -ῆς, ἡ
(< ἀνέχω, -ομαι), [in LXX: I Mac 12:25 (RV, respite)*;]
1. in cl., a holding back, delaying (MM, VGT, s.v.).
2.forbearance, delay of punishment: Ro 2:43:26.†
SYN.: μακροθυμία, ὑπομονή. ἀ., forbearance, is the result and expression of μ., which involves the idea of tolerance, long-suffering, as God with sinners. ὑ. expresses patience with respect to things, as μ. with persons; it is active as well as passive, denotes not merely endurance but perseverance (v. Tr., Syn., § liii; Lft., Notes, 259, 273; DB, ii, 47).

ἀνόμως.sd: lawlessly, i.e. (specially) not amenable to (the Jewish) law
ἀνόμως.as:
** ἀνόμως,
adv.
[in LXX: II Mac 8:17*;]
1.lawlessly (II Mac 8:17).
2. = χωρὶς νόμου, without law: Ro 2:12.†

ἀντιστρατεύομαι.as:
* ἀντι-στρατεύομαι,
to make war against: c. dat., Ro 7:23.†

ἀνεξεραύνητος.g: that cannot be searched into, inscrutable
ἀνεξεραύνητος.long: that cannot be searched into, inscrutable, unfathomable.
ἀνεξεραύνητος.sd: not searched out, i.e. (by implication) inscrutable
ἀνεξεραύνητος.der: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of G1830 (ἐξερευνάω);
ἀνεξεραύνητος.as:
** ἀνεξεραύνητος
(Rec. -εύνητος, as in Attic; M, Pr., 46), -ον (< ἐξ-ερευνάω), [in Sm. (-ευ-): Pr., 25:3*;]
unsearchable: Ro 11:33.†

ἀνεξιχνίαστος.sd: not tracked out, i.e. (by implication) untraceable
ἀνεξιχνίαστος.der: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of a compound of G1537 (ἐκ) and a derivative of G2487 (ἴχνος);
ἀνεξιχνίαστος.as:
† ἀνεξιχνίαστος, -ον
(< ἀ- neg., ἐξιχνιάζω, to track out; < ἴχνος), [in LXX: Jb 5:99:1034:24 (חֵקֶראֵין)*;]
that cannot be traced out: Ro 11:33, Eph 3:8 (MM, VGT, s.v.).†

ἀνακαίνωσις.long: renewing; a renewal or change of heart and life.
ἀνακαίνωσις.as:
† ἀνακαίνωσις, -εως, ἡ
(< ἀνακαινόω),
renewal: Ro 12:2, Tit 3:5 (Cremer, 324; MM, VGT, s.v.).†
SYN.: παλινγενεσία, in NT, new birth, of which ἀ. is the consequent renewal or renovation, in which man as well as God takes part (v. Tr., Syn., § xviii)

ἀναλογία.der: from a compound of G303 (ἀνά) and G3056 (λόγος);
ἀναλογία.as:
** ἀναλογία, -ας, ἡ
(< λόγος), [in Al.: Le 27:18*;]
proportion (MM, VGT, s.v.): Ro 12:6 (cf. Cremer, 397).†

ἀνυπόκριτος.der: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of G5271 (ὑποκρίνομαι);
ἀνυπόκριτος.as:
** ἀν-υπόκριτος, -ον
(< ἀ- neg., ὑποκρίνομαι), [in LXX: Wi 5:1818:16*;]
unfeigned: Ro 12:9, II Co 6:6, I Ti 1:5, II Ti 1:5, Ja 3:17, I Pe 1:22 (Cremer, 380; MM, VGT, s.v.).†

ἄνθραξ.as:
ἄνθραξ, -ακος, ὁ,
[in LXX chiefly for גַּחֶלֶת;]
coal, charcoal: . ἄ. πυρός, a burning coal, Ro 12:20.†

ἀνακεφαλαιόω.g: I sum up, summarize, recapitulate, gather up in one
ἀνακεφαλαιόω.long: I sum up, summarize, recapitulate, gather up in one.
ἀνακεφαλαιόω.kj: briefly comprehend, gather together in one
ἀνακεφαλαιόω.der: from G303 (ἀνά) and G2775 (κεφαλαιόω) (in its original sense);
ἀνακεφαλαιόω.as:
** ἀνα-κεφαλαιόω, ῶ
(v.s. κεφαλαιόω), [in Th., Al.: Ps 71 (72):20*;]
to sum up, gather up, present as a whole: mid., Ro 13:9, Eph 1:10 (on WH. v. Lft., Notes, 321 L; AR, in l.; Cremer, 354, 748).†

Ἀνδρόνικος.long: Andronicus, a member of the Roman church, and a kinsman or fellow-tribesman of Paul.
Ἀνδρόνικος.sd: man of victory; Andronicos, an Israelite

ἀνέγκλητος.der: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of G1458 (ἐγκαλέω);
ἀνέγκλητος.as:
** ἀν-έγκλητος, -ον
(< ἀ-, ἐγκαλέω), [in LXX: III Mac 5:31*;]
not to be called to account, unreprovable: I Co 1:8, Col 1:22, I Ti 3:10, Tit 1:6, 7.†
SYN.: ἄμεμπτος, ὀνεπίλημπτος (v. Tr., Syn., § ciii; Cremer, 742; MM, VGT, s.v.).

ἀνάξιος.der: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and G514 (ἄξιος);
ἀνάξιος.as:
ἀν-άξιος, -ον
(ἀ- neg., ἄξιος), [in LXX: Je 15:19א2 (זלל), Es 8:13, Si 25:8*;]
unworthy: c. gen., I Co 6:2 (MM, VGT, s.v.).†

ἀναξίως.as:
** ἀναξίως
(v. supr.), adv.,
[in LXX: II Mac 14:42*;]
in an unworthy manner: I Co 11:27.†

ἀντίλημψις.as:
ἀντί-λημψις, (Rec. -ληψις; v. MM, VGT s.v.; M, Pr., 56), -εως, ἡ
(< ἀντιλαμβάνομαι), [in LXX for עֹז, זְרוֹעַ, etc., freq. in Pss and II, III Mac.; freq. also in π. in petitions to the Ptolemies in sense of βοήθεια (v. Deiss., LAE, 107; BS, 92, 223);]
1. cl. a laying hold of, an exchange.
2. Hellenistic (LXX, π.) help: pl. of ministrations of deacons; I Co 12:28 (DB, ii, 347 f.; Cremer, 386).†

ἀνδρίζομαι.g: I act like a man, am brave
ἀνδρίζομαι.long: I act like a man, am brave.
ἀνδρίζομαι.as:
ἀνδρίζω,
[in LXX for חזק, אמץ (Jos 1:6 ff., I Ch 22:19, al.; in II Ki 10:12, Ps 27:1431:25 combined with κρατιοῦσθαι, as in I Co 16:13);]
to make a man of. Mid., to play the man (cf. MM, VGT, s.v.): I Co 16:13.†

ἀνακαλύπτω.der: from G303 (ἀνά) (in the sense of reversal) and G2572 (καλύπτω);
ἀνακαλύπτω.as:
ἀνα-καλύπτω
[in LXX chiefly for גָּלָה ni., pi.;]
to unveil: metaph. of removing hindrance to perception of spiritual things, II Co 3:143:18.†

ἀνακαινόω.der: from G303 (ἀνά) and a derivative of G2537 (καινός);
ἀνακαινόω.as:
ἀνα-καινόω, -ῶ
= ἀνακαινίζω (cf. MM, VGT, s.v.),
to make new: II Co 4:16, Col 3:10 (v. Cremer, 323).†

ἀνεκδιήγητος.g: indescribable, that cannot be thoroughly related
ἀνεκδιήγητος.long: indescribable, that cannot be thoroughly related, inexpressible.
ἀνεκδιήγητος.sd: not expounded in full, i.e. indescribable
ἀνεκδιήγητος.der: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of G1555 (ἐκδιηγέομαι);
ἀνεκδιήγητος.as:
*† ἀν-εκδιήγητος, -ον
(< ἀ-, ἐκδιηγέομαι),
inexpressible: II Co 9:15 (MM, VGT, s.v.).†

ἀναστροφή.long: dealing with other men, conduct, life, behavior, manner of life.
ἀναστροφή.as:
** ἀνα-στροφή, -ῆς, ἡ,
(< ἀναστρέφομαι), [in LXX: To 4:14, II Mac 5:86:23*;]
1.a turning down or back, a wheeling about (Soph., Thuc., al.).
2. In late writers (Polyb., al.; v.s. ἀναστρέφω, and cf. Hort on Ja 3:13; MM, VGT, s.v.), manner of life, behaviour, conduct: Ga 1:13, Eph 4:22, I Ti 4:12, He 13:7, Ja 3:13, I Pe 1:15, 182:123:1, 2, 16, II Pe 2:73:11.†

ἀνανεόω.long: I renew; mid: I renew myself, am renewed.
ἀνανεόω.der: from G303 (ἀνά) and a derivative of G3501 (νέος);
ἀνανεόω.as:
ἀνα-νεόω, -ῶ
(< νέος), [in LXX: Jb 33:24, Es 3:13, I, IV Mac8*;]
to renew: pass., Eph 4:23 (v. Cremer, 428; MM, VGT, s.v.)†

ἀνήκω.sd: to attain to, i.e. (figuratively) be proper
ἀνήκω.as:
ἀν-ήκω
(ἀνά, ἥκω), [in LXX: Jos 23:14 (בּוֹא), I Ki 27:8, Si. prol. 10, I, II Mac6*;]
prop., to have come up to; in later writers, impers. it is due, it is befitting: in ethical sense (MM, VGT, s.v.), Eph 5:4, Col 3:18; τὸ ἀνῆκον, Phm 8.†

ἀνθρωπάρεσκος.long: desirous of pleasing men, a renderer of service to human beings (as opposed to God).
ἀνθρωπάρεσκος.as:
† ἀνθρωπ-άρεσκος, -ον
(ἄνθρωπος, ἄρεσκος, pleasing), [in LXX: Ps 52 (53):5*;]
studying to please men: Eph 6:6, Col 3:22 (Cremer, 642; MM, VGT, s.v.).†

ἄνοιξις.as:
* ἄνοιξις, -εως, ἡ
(< ἀνοίγω),
an opening (in MGr., springtime): ἐν ἀ., as often as I open, Eph 6:19.†

ἀναθάλλω.long: I thrive or flourish again, revive.
ἀναθάλλω.as:
ἀνα-θάλλω
(< θάλλω, to flourish), [in LXX: Ps 28:7 (עלז), Ez 17:24 (פּרח hi.), Ho 8:9, Wi 4:4, Si 5:1-15*;]
to revive: Phl 4:10 (of MM, VGT, s.v.).†

ἀνταναπληρόω.g: I fill up in place of someone else
ἀνταναπληρόω.long: I fill up in place of someone else, complete, supply.
ἀνταναπληρόω.as:
* ἀντ-ανα-πληρόω, -ῶ
(ἀντί, ἀναπληρόω),
to fill up in turn: Col 1:24 (v. Lft., in l.; MM, VGT, s.v.).†

ἀνταπόδοσις.as:
ἀντ-από-δοσις, -εως, ἡ
(v. supr.), [in LXX chiefly for גְּמוּל, שִׁלּוּם;]
recompense: Col 3:24 (MM, VGT, s.v.).†

ἀνεψιός.der: from G1 (Α) (as a particle of union) and an obsolete (a brood);
ἀνεψιός.as:
ἀνεψιός, -οῦ, ὁ
(cf. Lat. nepos), [in LXX: Nu 36:11 (דּוֹדבֶּן), To 7:29:6א*;]
a cousin: Col 4:10 (MM, VGT, s.v.).†

ἀναμένω.long: I await (one whose coming is expected).
ἀναμένω.as:
ἀνα-μένω
[in LXX for קוה pi.;]
to await "one whose coming is expected, perhaps with the added idea of patience and confidence" c. acc., I Th 1:10 (v. M, Th., in l.; MM, VGT, s.v.).†

ἀνυπότακτος.sd: unsubdued, i.e. insubordinate (in fact or temper)
ἀνυπότακτος.kj: disobedient, that is not put under, unruly
ἀνυπότακτος.der: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of G5293 (ὑποτάσσω);
ἀνυπότακτος.as:
**† ἀνυπότακτος, -ον
(< ά- neg., ὑποτάσσω), [in Sm.: I Ki 2:1210:27 (for LXX, λοιμός, בּני בליעל)*;]
of things, not subject to rule: He 2:8; of persons, unruly: I Ti 1:9, Tit 1:6, 10 (MM, VGT, s.v.).†

ἀνόσιος.der: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and G3741 (ὅσιος);
ἀνόσιος.as:
ἀν-όσιος, -ον
(ἀ- neg., ὅσιος), [in LXX: Ez 22:9 (זִמָּה, Wi 12:4, II Mac 7:348:32, III Mac 2:25:7, IV Mac 12:11*;]
unholy, profane (Cremer, 464): I Ti 1:9, II Ti 3:2 (MM, VGT, s.v.).†

ἀνδροφόνος.as:
** ἀνδρο-φόνος, -ου, ὁ,
[in LXX: II Mac 9:28*;]
a man-slayer: I Ti 1:9 (cf. φονεύς, and v. MM, VGT, s.v.).†

ἀνδραποδιστής.long: an enslaver, one who forcibly enslaves, a kidnapper.
ἀνδραποδιστής.sd: an enslaver (as bringing men to his feet)
ἀνδραποδιστής.der: from a derivative of a compound of G435 (ἀνήρ) and G4228 (πούς);
ἀνδραποδιστής.as:
* ἀνδραποδιστής, -οῦ, ὁ
(< ἀνδράποδον, a slave, captured in war),
a slave-dealer, kidnapper: I Ti 1:10 (v. MM, VGT, s.v.).†

ἀντίλυτρον.as:
**† ἀντί-λυτρον, -ου, τό,
[in Al.: Ps 48 (49):9*;]
a ransom: I Ti 2:6 (v. CGT, in l.; and cf. λύτρον).†

ἀνεπίλημπτος.der: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of G1949 (ἐπιλαμβάνομαι);
ἀνεπίλημπτος.as:
* ἀν-επί-λημπτος (Rec. -λμπτος; Bl., § 6, 8), -ον
(< ἀ-, ἐπιλαμβάνω),
without reproach: I Ti 3:25:76:14.†
SYN.: ἄμεμπτος, ἀνέγκλητος. It is stronger than these, for it implies not only that the man is of good report, but that he is deservedly so (cf. MM, VGT, s.v.).

ἀντίθεσις.long: a proposition, tenet, opinion advanced by one party against another; opposition.
ἀντίθεσις.der: from a compound of G473 (ἀντί) and G5087 (τίθημι);

ἀναζωπυρέω.g: I stir up the fire, fan the flame of
ἀναζωπυρέω.long: I stir up the fire, fan the flame of.
ἀναζωπυρέω.der: from G303 (ἀνά) and a compound of the base of G2226 (ζῶον) and G4442 (πῦρ);
ἀναζωπυρέω.as:
** ἀνα-ζωπυργέω, -ῶ
(< ζωός, πῦρ), [in LXX: I Mac 13:7*;]
to kindle afresh: metaph., II Ti 1:6 (for vernac. exx., v. MM, VGT, s.v.).†

ἀναψύχω.sd: properly, to cool off, i.e. (figuratively) relieve
ἀναψύχω.as:
ἀνα-ψύχω,
[in LXX for נפשׁ ni., חיה, etc. (freq. in sense of revive, refresh oneself);]
to refresh: c. acc. pers., II Ti 1:16 (MM, VGT, s.v.; Cremer, 588).†

ἀνεπαίσχυντος.g: having no cause to be ashamed
ἀνεπαίσχυντος.long: having no cause to be ashamed.
ἀνεπαίσχυντος.der: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of a compound of G1909 (ἐπί) and G153 (αἰσχύνομαι);
ἀνεπαίσχυντος.as:
*† ἀν-επ-αίσχυντος, -ον
(< ἐπαισχύνομαι),
not to be put to shame: II Ti 2:15.†

ἀνατρέπω.long: I overturn (lit. or met.), subvert, overthrow, corrupt.
ἀνατρέπω.der: from G303 (ἀνά) and the base of G5157 (τροπή);
ἀνατρέπω.as:
ἀνα-τρέπω,
[in LXX for דּחה, הדף, etc.;]
to overturn, destroy: Jo 2:15 WH, txt.; metaph., to subvert (MM, VGT, s.v.): II Ti 2:18, Tit 1:11.†

ἀνεξίκακος.long: enduring evil, patient of evil, patiently forbearing.
ἀνεξίκακος.as:
*† ἀνεξί-κακος, -ον
(< fut., ἀνέξομαι, κακός),
patiently forbearing (cf. ἀνεξικακία, Wi 2:19; and v. MM, VGT, s.v.): II Ti 2:24.†

ἀντιδιατίθεμαι.sd: to set oneself opposite, i.e. be disputatious
ἀντιδιατίθεμαι.as:
*† ἀντι-δια-τίθημι,
in mid, to place oneself in opposition, oppose: II Ti 2:25 (EV; but v. Field, Notes, 215 f.; cf. MM, VGT, s.v.).

ἀνανήφω.g: I become sober again, recover sound sense
ἀνανήφω.long: I become sober again, recover sound sense.
ἀνανήφω.sd: to become sober again, i.e. (figuratively) regain (one's) senses
ἀνανήφω.as:
* ἀνα-νήφω
to return to soberness: metaph., II Ti 2:26 (cf. ἐκνήφω).†

ἀνήμερος.der: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and (lame);
ἀνήμερος.as:
* ἀν-ήμερος, -ον
(ἀ-, ἥμερο),
not tame, savage (MM, VGT, s.v.): II Ti 3:3.†

ἀνάλυσις.long: a loosing, departing, departure (from this life); (Probably a metaphor from the yoking and unyoking of transport animals).
ἀνάλυσις.as:
* ἀνά-λυσις, -εως, ἡ
(< ἀναλύω),
a loosing, e.g. of a vessel from its moorings, hence, departure: from life, II Ti 4:6.†

ἀνωφελής.der: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and the base of G5624 (ὠφέλιμος);
ἀνωφελής.as:
ἀν-ωφελής, -ές
(ἀ- neg., ὄφελος), [in LXX: Is 44:10 (הוֹעִילבִּלְתִּי), Je 2:8 (הוֹעִיללֹא), Pr 28:3, Wi 1:11*;]
unprofitable: Tit 3:9; neut. as subst., unprofitableness: He 7:18.†

ἀνακαινίζω.long: I make fresh again, renew, restore.
ἀνακαινίζω.der: from G303 (ἀνά) and a derivative of G2537 (καινός);
ἀνακαινίζω.as:
ἀνα-καινίζω
(< καινός), [in LXX: II Ch 15:8, Ps 102 (103):5103 (104):30, La 5:21 (חדשׁ pi., hith.)., Ps 38 (39):2 (עכר ni.), I Mac 6:9*;]
to renew: He 6:6 (Isocr., Plut.).†

ἀνασταυρόω.as:
* ἀνα-σταυρόω;
1.to impale (Hdt.).
2.to raise on a cross, crucify (Polyb., al.).
3.to crucify again: He 6:6 (v. Westc., in l.).†

ἀντιλογία.as:
ἀντιλογία, -ας ἡ
(< ἀντιλέγω), [in LXX chiefly for רִיב;]
gain-saying, strife (the latter sense being found in π.; v. MM, VGT, s.v.; cf. Field, Notes, 106): He 6:167:712:3, Ju 11.†

ἀντίτυπος.g: typical of, representing by type or pattern
ἀντίτυπος.long: typical of, representing by type (or pattern), corresponding to, an image.
ἀντίτυπος.der: neuter of a compound of G473 (ἀντί) and G5179 (τύπος);
ἀντίτυπος.as:
** ἀντί-τυπος, -ον
(v.s. τύπος), [in LXX: Es 3:13 A*;]
1. act. striking back; metaph., resisting, adverse.
2. Pass. struck back; metaph., corresponding to (MM, VGT, s.v.);
(a) as impression of a seal or copy of an archetype (τύπος) (RV, like in pattern), He 9:24;
(b) as the reality (of which τύπος is the copy or adumbration) (RV, after a true likeness), I Pe 3:21 (Cremer, 357).†

ἀνώτερος.g: higher, to a more honorable place, previously, above
ἀνώτερος.long: higher, to a more honorable place (at the dinner table); previously, in an earlier passage (or a book), above.
ἀνώτερος.sd: upper, i.e. (neuter as adverb) to a more conspicuous place, in a former part of the book
ἀνώτερος.as:
ἀνώτερος, α, -ον,
[in LXX: Ne 3:25 (עֶלְיוֹן), Ez 41:7 (מַעַל), To 8:3*;] only in neut., as adv. (cf. ἐξώτερος),
(a) of motion, higher: Lk 14:10;
(b) of rest, above, before: He 10:8.†

ἀναρίθμητος.long: uncountable, innumerable, that cannot be numbered.
ἀναρίθμητος.der: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of G705 (ἀριθμέω);

ἀναλογίζομαι.as:
** ἀνα-λογίζομαι
[in LXX: Wi 17:13א, II Mac 12:43 A, III Mac 7:7*;]
to consider: He 12:3 (MM, VGT, s.v.).†

ἀντικαθίστημι.sd: to set down (troops) against, i.e. withstand
ἀντικαθίστημι.as:
ἀντι-καθ-ίστημι,
[in LXX: De 31:21 (ענה), Jos 5:7, Mi 2:8 (קוּם)*;]
1. causal in pres. impf. fut. and 1 aor.; to replace, oppose.
2. Intrans. in pass. and 2 aor. act.;
(a)to supersede;
(b)to resist: He 12:4.†

ἀνταγωνίζομαι.as:
** ἀντ-αγωνίζομαι, depon.,
[in LXX: IV Mac 17:14*;]
to struggle against: seq. πρός, c. acc., He 12:4.†

ἀνεμίζομαι.g: I am blown with the wind
ἀνεμίζομαι.long: I am blown with the wind (referring to the gentler motions of the air).
ἀνεμίζομαι.as:
*† ἀνεμίζω = Attic ἀνεμόω
(< ἄνεμος);
pass., to be driven by the wind: Ja 1:6.†

ἄνθος.long: bloom, possibly a reference to the bright flowers, such as poppies (among the grass).
ἄνθος.as:
ἄνθος, -εος, τό,
[in LXX for צִיץ, etc.;]
a flower: Ja 1:10, 11, I Pe 1:24(LXX).†

ἀνέλεος.der: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and G2436 (ἵλεως);
ἀνέλεος.as:
*† ἀν-έλεος, -ον (Attic ἀνηλεής, ἀνελεήμων; MM, VGT, s.v.),
merciless: Ja 2:13.†

ἀναγεννάω.g: I beget again, beget into a new life
ἀναγεννάω.long: I beget again, beget into a new life.
ἀναγεννάω.as:
**† ἀνα-γεννάω, -ῶ
[in LXX: Sir prol. 17א* (ΑΒאcπαρα-)*;]
to beget again: metaph., of spiritual birth, I Pe 1:31:23 (cf. Cremer, 147; MM, VGT, s.v.).†

ἀνεκλάλητος.sd: not spoken out, i.e. (by implication) unutterable
ἀνεκλάλητος.der: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of G1583 (ἐκλαλέω);

ἀναζώννυμι.long: I gird up, brace up (with a view to active exertion); a metaphor from the girding of the flowing tunic, to prevent its hampering one in active work.
ἀναζώννυμι.as:
† ἀνα-ζώννυμι,
[in LXX: Jg 18:16, Pr 31:17 (חגר)*;]
to gird up: fig., τ. ὀσφύας τ. διανοίας, I Pe 1:13.†

ἀντιλοιδορέω.g: I abuse in return, give abuse for abuse
ἀντιλοιδορέω.long: I abuse in return, give abuse for abuse.
ἀντιλοιδορέω.as:
* ἀντι-λοιδορέω, -ῶ,
to revile in turn: I Pe 2:23.†

ἀνάχυσις.long: outpouring, excess, overflow, a pouring out.
ἀνάχυσις.der: from a comparative of G303 (ἀνά) and (to pour);
ἀνάχυσις.as:
*† ἀνά-χυσις, -εως, ἡ
(< ἀναχέω, to pour out),
a pouring out, overflowing, excess: metaph., I Pe 4:4 (MM, VGT, s.v.).†

ἀναγκαστῶς.long: by way of compulsion, unwillingly, by force, necessarily.
ἀναγκαστῶς.der: adverb from a derivative of G315 (ἀναγκάζω);
ἀναγκαστῶς.as:
* ἀναγκαστῶς
adv.,
necessarily or by constraint: opp. to ἑκουσίως, I Pe 5:2 (rare).†

ἀντίχριστος.long: antichrist, either one who puts himself in the place of, or the enemy (opponent) of the Messiah.
ἀντίχριστος.as:
*† ἀντί-χριστος, -ον, ὁ,
Antichrist, "one who assuming the guise of Christ opposes Christ" (Westc., Epp. Jo., 70): I Jo 2:18, 224:3, II Jo 7; pl. I Jo 2:18 (cf. ψευδόχριστος, and v. MM, VGT, s.v.).†

Ἀντιπᾶς.long: Antipas, a Christian martyr of Pergamum.
Ἀντιπᾶς.der: contracted for a compound of G473 (ἀντί) and a derivative of G3962 (πατήρ);
Ἀντιπᾶς.as:
Ἀντίπας (T, Ἀντείπας), -α (in some MSS. it appears to be indecl.; but v. M, Pr., 12; it is abbrev. from Ἀντίπατρος), ὁ,
Antipas: Re 2:13.†
